༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī badzra bhai ra ba kalba tant+ra rā dza/bod skad du/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ngag gi dbang phya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra bhai ra ba kalba tant+ra rā dza/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas 'dir ni bshad bya ba/ ji ltar 'gro rnams zad byed cing / /sdug bsngal rnam thar byed pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs chen mchog gyur pa/ /gsang sngags de las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad de/ /de dang nye bar ngag dbang phyug /rdo rje 'khor lo sgyur ba'o/ /gdon gyi bdag dang 'byung po'i rje/ /mi yi sa bon gnyis ldan bya/ /mchod rten sreg byed mtha' dang bcas/ /gzhan du shes par mi 'gyur te/ /rdo rje can gyi mkha' la gnas/ /yi ge 'bum phrag khri brjod na/ /nyams pa thams cad sel byed cing / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang mngon spyod/ /gsod dang skrod dgug dbye rings dang / /dman par byed dang rgyal srid sogs/ /thob pa nyid la the tshom med/ /dur khrod tshang tshing khrod ngogs rtsub/ /shing gcig khang stong mtshan gcig dben/ /gang 'dod gnas su bsam gtan brtsam/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'phrul pa thams cad la khyab pa me long lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sku dang ye shes thams cad la khyab par bya ba'i phyir/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal lnga dag ldan par byas nas/ 'jig rten pa thams cad la gzugs nas/ rang gi rigs kyi ye ge nyid brjod pas/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang / phreng las dang / ye shes kyang gcig gi ngo bor sprul pa'i skur gyur to/ /kye ma bcom ldan rdo rje che/ /don rnams bskyed pa yang nyid do/ /mkha' dkyil 'od kyis 'gengs 'gyur ba/ /slar zhing kha dog lnga ldan pa/ /sa bon sngags kyis bskul ba yi/ /'od kyi rtse phrag thub pa'i sku/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas gnas las skyes/ /rang la zhugs pas sku rdzogs 'gyur/ /zhal drug khro gnyer rab brjid pa/ /ma he'i zhal ldan steng gnas pa/

/'jam dpal zhal ni 'dzum bcas bzhugs/ /lhag ma dmar dang ser dang sngo/ /du ba'i mdog mtshungs gyen skrar ldan/ /thod pa skam rlon rgyu ma sbrul/ /rus pa rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan/ /glang chen stag lpags gyon nas ni/ /hūm̐ phaṭ glur len gad mo can/ /nam mkha'i lus can khro bo'i sprin/ /yang dang yang du spro byed pa'i/ /phyag drug rab tu brjid pa ste/ /dbyug pa tho ba gtun shing dag /g.yas pa'i phyag gis rim bzhin 'dzin/ /dgra sta dang ni lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa g.yon pa'i phyag gis 'dzin/ /padma nyi ma ma he dang / /gshin rje'i steng na 'gying bag can/ /zhabs drug g.yon brkyang gar gyis gnas/ /'jig rten bdag po mthar mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar gang zhig dad pa dang / /blo ldan g.yo sgyu rab spangs shing / /legs par dbang rnams thob byas nas/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyes byed pas/ /yang nas yang du dran byed na/ /brtan pa chen po thob par 'gyur/ /lha yi dge 'dun nga la nyon/ /dpa' bo 'chang la rab dga' zhing / /sha chen rtag tu mur byed na/ /las rnams de yis myur du 'grub/ /sku ni du ma 'phro byed cing / /sku la sku rnams nges thim byed/ /thams cad sgyu ma nyid shes pas/ /'jig rten rnams su yid sad byed/ /khong stong rtsa ni ka ba ste/ /rgyun du byang chub sems 'dzag byed/ /chu skyes dmar po kha sbyar gnyis/ /yan lag gnyis kyis legs par bcun/ /shes pa 'phel ba me dang rlung / /nyi ma zla ba thabs ldan dang / /shes rab ldan par shes par bya/ /gnyis po de nyid rnams spangs na/ /khong du chud par mi 'gyur ro/ /chu skyes kha sbyor la brten te/ /gsum gnas pa yi ting 'dzin la/ /rdo rje chos kyis rjes btab pa'i/ /thams dang shes rab grol ba'i rgyu/ /blo ldan 'bad pas shes par 'gyur/ /de phyir de la brtson par bya/ /chos rnams chos nyid dbyer med pas/ /stong pa de nyid kyi ye shes che/ /mi shigs rtog bral mtshan ma med/

/bde chen ye shes rdo rje'i skur/ /ye shes la mi rtog rtog pa bral/ /rtog pa'i mtshan pa thams cad sreg /spros pa'i mtshan ma mtha' dag ni/ /ji snyed sgyu ma'i rnam pa shes/ /de nyid shes nas grol ba'o/ /mi shes pas ni phyir zhing 'khor/ /'jig rten skye bo blo ldan 'gas/ /nges pa rtog pa thabs kyi mchog /sdug bsngal chen po rab 'jigs nas/ /bde ba 'dod pas nan tan bya/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bsam gtan bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sngags grub pa las byung ba yi/ /las rnams 'dir ni shes bya ste/ /der ni lha yi sku yang sbyar/ /zhi sogs bzlas pa'i rim pa la/ /rdo rje'i dbus su rdo rje ni/ /nyi zla la brten yi ge yi/ /phreng ba kha dog lngar shes pa/ /skyes bul spangs nas bklag pa ni/ /mkhas pas bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /drag po'i las rnams sgrub pa la/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /ser po rtse rtsibs bcu pa la/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba bsam/ /zhi bar 'dod pa'i skyes bu des/ /sems ni yang dag mnyam gzhag nas/ /sngags kyi 'od kyang 'gro gzhan la/ /phan pa'i yid dang ldan par bya/ /gro ba ras dang shing shun la/ /gur gum gi wang dri rnams kyis/ /mchod rten rim pa lngar ldan zhing / /gdugs dang 'khor lo ldan par bya/ /sgrub pa po yi ming dang rus/ /de yi bum pa'i nang du bri/ /ye dharma la sogs pa yi/ /sngags kyis g.yon nas bskor bar bri/ /cig shos g.yas nas g.yon du bri/ /de la spel tshig mang ba'am/ /yang na 'khor lo'i bar du gzhag /'khor lo kun la kha sbyor gnad/ /rab tu gnas par byas nas kyang / /lus sam mgul lam gang bder gzhag /des ni gdon dang byad stims dang / /rims dang yams rnams sel bar byed/ /gang zhig yul rnams gzhom 'dod na/ /hūm̐ gi sa bon dang ldan par/ /ming yig tsam po bri bar bya/

/so phag phye ma ldong ros dang / /ba bla ma he'i khrag gis brdzis/ /zla gam gnyis pa'i gzugs byas te/ /bar du gang 'dod bsgrub bya yi/ /gzugs brnyan sor brgyan pa yi tshad/ /byas la gan rkyal du gzhag la/ /ma he gdong gi sbyor ba yis/ /khro phrag gcig tu sngags bzlas nas/ /dum bu dum bur gtubs byas te/ /chu bo'i gzhung du dor byas na/ /skad cig de la de dbang 'gyur/ /bya rog 'ug pa'i gzugs byas te/ /ma nu ma li ro tsa nas/ /khyo shug bsgrub bya'i ming bris te/ /gshin rje'i phyogs bltas gsang sngags gdon/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan nas ni/ /mi yi rje ngar phur pas gdab/ /skad cig tsam la de dag byed/ /de nas 'dir ni bsad pa yi/ /cho ga'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug gam/ /yang na zhal gcig phyag bzhi'am/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yang dung / /ma te'i gdong gi sbyor ba yis/ /khrog rnams sna tshogs tha dad dang / /bsgrub bya'i rjes dang dug gi rigs/ /rta dang ma he bong bu'i chus/ /sbrus pa'i bsgrub bya'i ling ga bya/ /lus la tsher mas gzugs bya zhing / /til mar gyis kyang bsku bar bya/ /yang ni shing lo gro ga'am/ /dur khrod ras sam shun pa la/ /rang nyid gcor bu skra bshig nas/ /lus ni thal bas byugs byas te/ /mngon sum khros nas sha chen bza'/ /rab tu zhim pa'i chang 'thung zhing / /nag po'i chos kyi mtshan phyed dus/ /'khor lo bri ba brtsam par bya/ /le tshe bcu gnyis 'khor lo ni/ /hūm̐ dang hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥdabus su dgod/ /ṇa yo ni ra rtsibs mchan la/ /yungs kar til dang skags khu dang / /rta dang ma he ra khyi khrag /bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro yis bri/ /yi ge ya yi lto bar yang / /ming dang rus su ldan par bri/ /phyogs bzhir yi ge bcu pa ni/ /ming dang bcas pa bri bar bya/ /brgyad po dag la rim pa bzhin/ /yi ge 'di dag bri bar bya/ /oṃ mu sa le tsurna ra ga tsar sha na tsu sha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/

yi ge ya la bskor nas ni/ /bsgrub bya gzugs dang ldan par bri/ /de yi mu khyud dag la ni/ /yi ge bcu la ming bcas bri/ /phyogs bzhir rtse gsum rdo rjes mtshan/ /de bzhin rdzas rnams ma lus pas/ /'khor lo lto bar ldan pa bri/ /gshin rje'i gzugs ni ral gri dang / /dbyug pa 'dzin pa bris nas ni/ /de dang de gnyis lto sbyar la/ /mtshan ngan thod pa'i nang du gzhug /tsha gsum ske tshe dug mu zi/ /ro nyes bkang nas dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru gsum dbus su gzhag par bya/ /yungs dang bra bar sā lu nag /dzabhi bra bo sogs rnams la/ /gsang sngags rgyal po brjod byas te/ /dro'am du ba 'thul bar du/ /rims dang rims kyi khrag rnams ni/ /ma lus zad par 'thung ba yis/ /ma yengs par ni bsam gtan bya/ /yang na bsgrub bya za bar mthong / /shing gcig rtsar ni rengs pa dang / /mal gyi 'og tu zha zhing lkugs/ /chu mdor 'byed cing ri rtser bskrad/ /gsad pa me thab 'og tu sba/ /dgug pa la ni sgo khang 'og /lha'am 'khor lo sgyur ba'o/ /bde gnas rnams kyis dbang du 'gyur/ /mar khu chen po thod pa yi/ /nang du blugs nas bskol byas te/ /bzhar bas mig la byug byed na/ /mngon shes de nyid myur du 'thob/ /rigs ldan rgyal po las rnyed cing / /mdog ldan lang tsho gsar bkug la/ /tsandan lde khu mang byas te/ /las kyi sbyor bas de nyid bcing / /yang na me la gdung bas 'grub/ /oṃ badzra kro dha ya rā ma dzaḥbadzra kī li kī li/ ha na ha na mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces bya'i gsang sngags brjod byas la/ /rus pa'i phur bas gdab par bya/ /gsal shing la gtsug skyes bu yi/ /rdzas la brten te bsgrub par bya/ /til mar byugs la thod pas bzhar/ /mar mer byas pa'i dud pa yis/ /mig rnon dag ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags rgyal po thogs med la/ /bsten pas thob bya mang mod kyang / /'dir ni brjod pa ci zhig dgos/ /yang na 'di ltar shes bya ste/

/rang nyid sngags dang ting 'dzin ldan/ /brtson chen gzhan du ma yengs pas/ /gang du brtsams pa de 'grub 'gyur/ /smad 'tshod rang byung nyid kyis ni/ /sngon bstan tsakra legs bris te/ /ling ga'i snying gar bcug byas la/ /rang mdun khrag gi zla gam steng / /khrag gis byugs pa'i steng du gzhag /mi'am rgyal po'i bu mo dag /dgug dang dbang gi yi ge yis/ /de nyid du ni nges par 'gyur/ /nyal sa'i 'og tu mnan par bya/ /mi glang ra khyi bse phag khrag /'khor lo bris nas ling ga yi/ /mgrin par bcug na bya rog gi /khrag gis khrag skyug sngags bris nas/ /yi ge de ldan thod pa ru/ /bcug nas gsang sngags mang bzlas te/ /dur khrod me thab 'og bzhag na/ /khrag skyag pa la the tshom med/ /bsros na tsha ba'i nad kyis 'chi/ /sbal khrag pha wang klad pa yis/ /'khor lo de nyid legs bris nas/ /ling ga'i mchan khung g.yon bcug la/ /g.yas g.yon glang khrag sbal khrag byug /ling ga'i phyogs su rang nyid kyi/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mnan/ /de tshe bzlas pa mang byas nas/ /rgya gram lam du mnan la gzhag /de las zlog pa bris nas ni/ /shing gcig khang par sbas na rengs/ /rnga mo bya rog rgan po'i khrag /'khor lo bris nas ling ga yi/ /rkang gnyis bar bcug rang mdun du/ /khrag gis rnga mo gzugs bris te/ /de yi steng gzhag rang nyid kyis/ /rlung gi bsam gtan nges ldan na/ /bskrad pa nyid du the tshom med/ /ri bo'i rtse la 'dzegs te sba/ /ne'u le sbrul rta ma he dang / /bya rog 'ug pa'i khrag gis ni/ /khyo shug rkang pa'i rjes sbrus pa'i/ /ling ga sor brgyad par byas te/ /khrag des bris pa'i 'khor lo dag /snying gar bcug pa gnyis byas te/ /ne'u le gzugs byas steng du gzhag /lag gnyis rta dang ma he yi/ /rus pas brdung zhing gsang sngags zlos/ /rtse 'drud shing rtsar sbas na 'byer/ /tsandan dkar pos legs bris nas/ /gser sogs rin chen rdzas su dril/

/mdun du zla ba'i gzugs steng du/ /gzhag la nyin re'i bskor ba ni/ /ji sred byas na bsrung bar nges/ /spyi bor btags na g.yul las rgyal/ /rkang par btags na chu steng 'gro/ /ba yi 'o mas khrus byas te/ /ku sha ba mar sogs mchod na/ /gsol btab nad rnams thams cad srung / /de nas bcom ldan 'das las phra ba thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms pa zhugs nas/ las thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sngags 'di sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mā ra ya phaṭ ces bsad pa'i 'o/ /bi dwe ṣpa ya dbye ba'i 'o/ /utstshaṭa ya bskrad pa'i'o/ /mo ha ya rmongs pa'i 'o/ /ba sham̐ ku ru dbang du bya pa'i 'o/ /stambha ya mnan pa'i'o/ /ā karṣa ya dzaḥdagug pa'i 'o/ /oṃ hrīḥswā hā mchod pa'i 'o/ /oṃ i dam̐ gha swā hā zhal bsil gyi'o/ /oṃ duṣṭa swā hā dri'i 'o/ /oṃ bho yam̐ dzaḥdza me tog gi'o/ /oṃ ṣṭi ha he phaṭ phaṭ/ bdug pa'i 'o/ /oṃ dī po dha na ma ya swā hā/ mar me'i 'o/ oṃ badzra nai bidya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhal zas kyi 'o/ /oṃ kā la rū pa sa twa da ma ka ma hā bhū ta pa ti/ i dam̐ ba li gṛhna pa ya gri hna pa ya swā hā/ gtor ma'i 'o/ /oṃ hrīḥya ma rwa dza e hye he ā gatstsha ā gatstsha bha ga bā na sarb+ba mām̐ sa me da madzdza/ rudhi ra pri ye bha kṣa bha kṣa/ ma ma sarb+ba sa twa da pa ka karma ku ru singhi mme swā hā lha spyan drang pa'i'o/ /oṃhrīḥbadzra dza ye su dza ye ma hā badzra dza ye mu ni badzra muḥlha la sogs pa gshegs su gsol ba'i 'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba dang / ldog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ /gsang sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i phrin las 'di nyid bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyis dbus gnas par/ /hūm̐ las yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bsam par bya/

/dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /shes rab mo dang mnyam du sbyor/ /dbyug pa thod khrag phyag na 'dzin/ /ma he padma nyi ma la/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi tshul gyis bsgom/ /oṃ ya mānta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di bzlas na/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'byung / /nam mkha'i dbyings su dbus su gnas par/ /ya yig sngon po las skyes pa'i/ /khro bo rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ /padma nyi ma'i gdan steng na/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i/ /gri gug bi dhi pa la dang / /dgra sta dang ni thon khrag dang / /phyag bzhi po ni ring pas 'dzin/ /ma he nag po zhal steng na/ /'jam dpal zhal ni ser zhing 'dzum/ /dpa' bo chen po rang nyid bsgom/ /rab tu zhim pa'i chang btung zhing / /sha chen dag kyang mur bar bya/ /mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu byed cing / /rtag par gsang sngags bzla bar bya/ /thig le 'dren pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bsgrub bya'i phyogs su bsam par bya/ /las rnams myur du 'dis 'grub bo/ /yang na 'di ltar shes bya ste/ /ma he gdong gi sbyor ba yi/ /sku yi kha dog so sor shes/ /khyad par du yang gsad pa la/ /nag po ma he'i zhal can ni/ /rtse gsum lcags kyu 'dzin pa ste/ /ma he sha steng bsam byas na/ /khrag 'dren pa yi mchog tu gsungs/ /res 'ga' sku la khro bo ni/ /lcags kyu 'dzin pa grangs med spro/ /zla ba spyang kis zin dus su/ /byi la'i sder mo ra snying dang / /bya yi khrag dang mi rus bsres/ /gang la phog pa smyo bar 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sbyor ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sgrub par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dur khrod ras sam dpa' bo'i gos/ /yang na mtshan gyi kheb ma la/ /rnam snang mdzad dang rdo rje chus/ /dpa' bo'i khrag dang chang dang dug /go ro tsa nas ras tshos bya/ /legs par dam por drud byas te/

/lus ngag yid kyi gnas su ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i chus/ /yi ge oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ bri/ /skra phyed dur khrod sol ba dang / /khrag chen ldong ros ba bla yis/ /dbang thob dam tshig srung byed cing / /shin tu gsang la dam pa pa yi/ /ri mo mkhan ni brtson ldan des/ /rgyud kyi don la mkhas byas nas/ /dag po'i tshes kyi mtshan phyed dus/ /gsang ba'i gnas su rab bzhugs nas/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs mdzad bri/ /rtsa ba ma he khros pa'i zhal/ /de ste 'jam dpal 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /lhag ma dmar dang ser dang sngo/ /du ba'i mdog mtshungs gyen skra can/ /rab tu brjid cing khro bo'i zhal/ /drug dang ldan pa'i sku lus che/ /thod pa skam rlon rgyu ma sprul/ /rus pa rdo rje phreng bas brgyan/ /glang chen stag lpags gyon nas ni/ /padma nyi ma ma he la/ /gshin rje mnan nas zhabs drug gis/ /g.yos brkyang g.yas bskum gar gyis 'gying / /phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na/ /rtse gcig gnyis tho ba ste/ /gsum pa gtun shing mkha' la 'phyar/ /dgra sta lcags kyu zhags pa ni/ /g.yos pa'i phyag gis 'dzin pa bri/ /nam mkha'i mdog can thal bas byugs/ /sku la khro bo du ma 'phro/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i lha mos bskor/ /legs par de ltar bris pa yis/ /rgyab dang phyogs rnams thams can du/ /dur khrod chen pos bskor bar bri/ /mgo rdum rgyu ma mkha' la khyer/ /rkang rdum lag rdum ro langs dang / /wa dang spyang ki gtum po dang / /mkha' 'gro pho mo sha za'i tshogs/ /bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs bri/ /skyi bung rab tu 'jigs bris nas/ /der ni sgrub pa po yang bri/ /gri thod bzung nas sha chen mur/ /gos nag gyon nas khrag chen 'thung / /rta dang ma he rus pa yi/ /phreng ba bzung nas gsang sngags 'don/ /bcom ldan 'das la lta bar bri/ /de ltar bris nas chang dang khrag /sha chen go ro tsa nas mchod/ /mnyam gzhag lha yi dge 'dun des/ /dus gsum rgyun du mchod byed na/

/rdo rje 'dzin pa myur du 'thob/ /sku ni rab tu sba zhing gsang / /phan yon dam pa 'di las 'byung / /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las bris sku'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rtog pa ma lus zad byed cing / /lus rnams thams cad grub 'dod pas/ /blo ldan ser sna rnam spangs te/ /rtul phod g.yeng pa rnam spangs nas/ /sbyin sreg las la rab brtson bya/ /mtshal dang ba bla ldong ros dang / /shan pa'i go thal dur khrod sa/ /mi dang ma he khrag gis brdzi/ /khru do pa la khru phyed brtsig /grub bzhi'i steng du zlum po ni/ /rdo rje rgya gram ldan byas la/ /de steng 'khor lo rtsibs drug la/ /mtshan ma drug ni dgod par bya/ /lte bar mi yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /mtho gang tshad du byas pa la/ /ma he'i khrag gis legs par byug /bdag nyid lho yis phyogs bltas te/ /ma he zhal gyi sbyor ba yis/ /thab kyi nang gi phyogs mtshams su/ /me yi sa bon mngon bltas la/ /bskal pa'i me chen lta bur bsgom/ /der ni me lha'ang bsgom bya ste/ /zhal gsum phyag bzhi gnag la rtsub/ /phyag gnyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'gro rnams la/ /skyabs sbyin mdzad cing bgrad phreng 'dzin/ /g.yos pas ril ba mchog stsol brtson/ /zhabs drug rigs drug mtshan ma brdzis/ /zhal nas me rnams rab 'phro zhing / /'od rnams sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ /de ltar shes nas rab bsregs na/ /'dod pa'i don rnams rab tu 'byung / /dgra bo'i gzugs dang sha chen dang / /chang dang ma he'i khrag bcas pa/ /stong phrag gsum du bsregs byas na/ /bsgrub bya khrag tu skyugs nas 'chi/ /glang po rta bong khyi sha la/ /stong phrag gsum gyis dbang du byed/ /bya rog 'ug pa khyi sha chu/ /bsregs na mi rta 'byer bar nges/ /til dang nas dang gro sā lu/ /yung ba gi wang so phag rnams/ /stong phrag drug tu gang bsregs pa/

/longs spyod thams cad rnyed par 'gyur/ /rta dang rnga mo bya rog sha/ /mi sha rdo rje chur bcas pa/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor ldan byas te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis nges par skrod/ /ra sha da na utpa la/ /chang dang ma he chur bcas pa/ /gang 'dod brgya rtsa brgyad kyi lkugs/ /dug dang khrag dang sgog pa dang / /sha chen til mar rab sbags te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsregs byas na/ /pha rol gzhan gyi rig sngags gcod/ /tsandan dkar po 'bras dkar dang / /til dkar 'bras chan yungs kar dang / /utpal dkar dmar ga bur dag /shar du bltas te brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bsregs nas dus rnams kun tu bsrung / /gang zhig bya ba'i rims sogs dang / /sngags rnams bsam gtan nges ldan pas/ /snying rje'i yid ni ma bral na/ /'dod pa thams cad 'dir bsgrub bya/ /gzhan du rmongs pa'i byis pa 'ga'/ /blo gros med gang shes rab 'chal/ /sngags dang dam tshig dman gyur cing / /ting nge 'dzin la mngon g.yel ba/ /brtson pa chung zhing lhod pa 'gas/ /bskal pa stong du bsgrubs bya kyang / /'bras bu yod pa ma yin te/ /sha thang chad pa nyid du 'gyur/ /dper na blo zhan byis pa rnams/ /'ga' zhig 'bras 'dod 'khrul gyur nas/ /phub ma rlung khar byed pa la/ /'bras yid nam yang mi 'gyur bzhin/ /ji ltar sprin dang chu zla dang / /dbang po'i gzhu rnams rtag min te/ /thar pa 'dod pa'i bya ba'ang de/ /sgyu ma nyid la sgyu ma rol/ /ye shes gcig pu rnam grol rgyu/ /stong pa dpag par blos ci nus/ /de la dpyad cing gzhal bzod na/ /brtags pa'i snying po de la med/ /de la dngos rnams ma grub na/ /bsgrub pa'i rim gzhan smos ci dgos/ /bya ba dang ni byed pa dag /nges par de la brtag mi bzod/ /ngan grog g.yang sar lhung yang bla'i/ /chad par rtog pa 'di mi bzod/ /rtag pa nyid kyang rig min te/ /dngos po yod pa ga la 'gyur/ /dper na byis pa rnams la mas/ /sa 'dis sdod dang ma nyid kyis/

/'bras bu shing tog mang blangs la/ /khyod la bde bas sbyin zhes brjod/ /de bzhin rnam pa du ma yang / /'jig rten rtog pa tha dad pas/ /de dag drang bar bya phyir bshad/ /bcom ldan lha yi lha mdun du/ /sha chen po yi zhal zas dang / /chang dang til mar ma he khrag /rab tu zhim pa'i zas mchog rnams/ /dus rnams rtag tu dbul bar bya/ /gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge bcu/ /bdag gis rgyun du gdon bya zhing / /bsam gtan rtag tu brtson par bya/ /de ltar shes shing sgrub byed pa'i/ /skyes bu blo ldan de yis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang myur 'grub 'gyur/ /zhi sogs las rnams smos ci dgos/ /grong khyer dkrug na sngags pa des/ /khyi sha sbal sha rus sbal sha/ /rnga mo byi la'i sha rnams la/ /stong rtsa brgyad du bsreg par bya/ /rta sha dri chen rab sbyar bas/ /ril bu byas te bdag mdun du/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas byas nas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsregs pas ni/ /rgyal po dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /bud med dbang du byed 'dod na/ /nya sha chang dang sha chen rnams/ /rdo rje chu yis sbags byas te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsreg par bya/ /tha mal dbang du byed 'dod na/ /sha chen glang po'i sha dang bcas/ /byang chum sems dang bsres byas te/ /stong phrag brgyad du bsreg par bya/ /dgug pa dus rnams thams cad du/ /khyi sha nya sha bdud rtsi lnga/ /cha mnyam ril bu byas nas ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsregs nas 'gugs/ /sbyin sreg las rnams thams cad kyang / /ma he zhal gyi sbyor bas ni/ /gsang sngags rgyal pos 'dod pa sbyor/ /ma yengs rtse gcig sems kyis bya/ /gsungs dang ma gsungs mtha' dag kyang / /ji lta ba yi rim pa yis/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid nyer gnas/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu myur du 'thob/ /zhi la zhi ba'i yid kyis te/ /rgyal po lta bur rgyas pa la/ /sdang bral chags pas dbang la'o/ /drag po'i las la khro zhing rtsib/

/rab tu gtum pa'i yid kyis ni/ /gsod pa'i sems dang ldan par bya/ /gang zhig ltos pa med pa'i mi/ /grub pa myur du tshol byed na/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de 'grub 'gyur/ /dngos po gang dang gang spyod yul/ /de dang de yi rang bzhin 'gro/ /mnyam gzhag nyams par mi bya la/ /dus rnams rtag tu rnal 'byor pas/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag par bya/ /des ni thar pa nyid kyi rgyu/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di las ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub myur byed de/ /dka' ba med pa'i thabs 'di ni/ /dka' spyod brtul zhugs rnams spangs te/ /shing tu bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs/ /sdug bsngal 'jigs med bdud rtsi'i ro/ /blo ldan legs par blang bya ste/ /shing tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ /mi shes blo gros rmongs pa 'ga'/ /rtog pa'i dra bas bsgribs pa'i tshe/ /bsod nams dang ni sdug pa yi/ /phung po rnam pa gnyis su brtags/ /'od kyang 'dod pa thams cad ni/ /rgyud mchod 'dis las 'byung 'gyur phyir/ /dman zhing brtson pa chung ba 'ga'/ /'di la zhugs na myur du 'grub/ /de bas ngo mtshar rgyud 'di ni/ /rnyed dka' khyad par mchog gyur pa/ /yi ge'i dbyibs kyang mi bstan nas/ /bshad cing 'grol ba smos ci dgos/ /dbang rnams nges par ma blangs shing / /bla ma mnyes par ma byas tshe/ /bstan kyang thob par mi 'gyur te/ /tsha ba la sogs 'khor bar 'khor/ /de skad ston pas bshad pa'i tshe/ /sde rnams myos shing brgyal rmongs te/ /kun kyang 'dud cing mgo bo smad/ /'jig rten 'di ni shig tu g.yos/ /gang zhig rgyud 'di nyan pa dang / /shes nas 'chang bar byed pa dang / /dus rnams kun tu 'don byed nas/ /tshe 'di 'jigs pa kun bsal te/ /shi nas mtho ris myur du 'thob/ /gal te gzhan du rgyud mchog 'di/ /bstan nam bshad dam gsal phye na/ /de ni sdug bsngal mang myong nas/ /shi nas myur du dmyal bar 'gro/

/rang gis shin tu bcang byas shing / /dngos grub nyid bzhin mngon byas na/ /sdug bsngal mtha' dag nges zad nas/ /myur du bla med thob par 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sbyin sreg gi rim par phye ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyun kyi rgyal po'i las kyi dngos grub brtag pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta chen po a mo gha'i zhabs nus pa can dang / bod kyi lotstsha ba mar ba bande chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/ /slad kyi grub thob chen po karṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ thar pa lo tstsha ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bcom ldan nyid kyi sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje rnams las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yis/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i phar rgal nas/ /de nas gshin rje'i grong khyer ni/ /ga la ba yi gnas su byin/ /mi bzad zhabs ni bcu drug gis/ /lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug brdzis/ /ye shes rtse gcig mtshan ma yis/ /dbus kyi lcags mkhar chen po brdzis/ /de tshe bdud chen las brgyal nas/ /ha ha hi hi'i sgra sgrogs pas/ /chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa/ /gzir bzhin du ni rab smras pa/ /dpa' bo chen po ga la ci/ /dpa' bo'i dgos pa bdag gis bgyi/ /bdag cag srog gi snying po rnams/ /tshul bzhin 'bul gyis dpa' bos bzhes/ /lha ma srin ni sde brgyad kyis/ /srog gi yang snying phul ba ni/ /gshin rjes ya phul ma mos ma/ /srin pos ra phul gnod sbyin kṣe/ /mi yis ṇi phul sa bdag sa/ /btsan gyis tsa phul bdud kyis da/ /de rnams gcig du dril ba ni/ /bran du yang ni khas blangs so/ /gtan tshigs chen po de yi phyir/ /ye shes lha yi dgongs pa dang /

/bsnyen pa nyams 'og rab chub nas/ /lha yi bsnyen pa la chud nas/ /sngon gyi thugs dam las mi 'da'/ /mi 'grub pa ni mi srid do/ /ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ de skad ces ni smras pa dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yis/ /chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa/ /gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad kun/ /sgrol ba'i ging du byin gyis brlabs/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo rnams/ /'khor bcas rnams la bka' bsgo ba/ /lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /nga yi bstan pa 'byung ba'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin ldan pa la/ /bka' bsgo'i las rnams tshul bzhin gyis/ /ces pas dam bcas pa dang mnan bzhin du mna' bor ro/ /gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa rdzogs so// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ /tstshu tstshun dha ra kalpa na maḥ/ bod skad du/ te'u lo pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba gshin rje'i gshed po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas tstshu tstshun dha ra'i cho ga zhib mo bshad par bya ste/ oṃ tu tra ya ma he shar yo ga pratta ma ya/ yo ga siddhi/ dā hā ni me swā hā/ hū ha/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ /ur dhi ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ rig sngags 'di'i bya ba'i cho ga ni/ /nyin mtshan du mi nyal bar dri dang me tog dang / bdug spos phul nas/ gtor ma btang ste stong phrag brgyad bzlas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas las rnams su 'gyur ba ni/ /tstshu tstshun dhar shi ba blangs la/ pags pa dang rus pa dang / sha dang spu rnams phye mar btags te stong phrag gnyis bzlas nas phye ma de dpral bar byugs na bdag nyid dgras mi mthong / oṃ ma ma hū pa ti/ /phye ma de lag pa la bskul nas gang la reg pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de rkang pa la bskul nas dpag tshad brgyar song na yang ldog go /phye ma de nyid kyi dgra'i sgo logs la bskul nas khyim gyi sgor stong phrag brgyar bzlas na skrod par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de dang dur khrod kyi ras dgra bo'i sgo rtsar bcad cing sbas na dgra bo'i rigs rnams 'joms par 'gyur ro/

/yang na dgra bo'i rigs skrod par 'dod na tstshu tstshun dha ra'i pags pa phye mar btags la/ stong phrag brgyad yongs su bzlas nas gcin shul gyi sas bkang nas skud pa sngon pos bcings te nam mkhar bteg na gcin 'gags par 'gyur ro/ /bkrol na ni thar ro/ /tstshu tstshun dha ra'i pags pa phye mar btags nas lha chen po'i mdun du stong phrag brgyad bzlas la yang dri dang me tog dang bdug spos dang gtor ma btang ste/ slar yang stong phrag brgyad bzlas na des 'grub par 'gyur te/ /phye ma de sna'i rtse mor bskul na skye 'gro thams cad la sdug par 'gyur ro/ /mgo bor bzhag na dgra thams cad dang 'gyed pa'i lan thebs par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de nyid rang gi snying gar bskus nas dgra la bstan na snying na bar 'gyur ro/ /sā lu'i phye ma la gzugs byas nas phye ma de bskus nas mdzes thebs par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi thal pa dang bcas pas dgra bo'i tshogs la gtor na gang gis mnan pa dang mthong ba de dag nad kyis thebs par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de la lan stong bzlas nas gang gi mgo bor blugs pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de thod pa dang lhan cig sgo logs su bzhag na dgra bo dang dbye bar 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de bud med kyi lag pa la bskus na bud med de 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de gang gi sgor sbas na skrod par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de sha chen po dang bsres nas gang gi btung bar sbyin na nyi ma bdun gyis 'chi'o/ /phye ma de dgra la byin la dgra bo bkres pa dang / gzhang 'brum dang / tshad pas thebs nas phyi nas ni rang nyid dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /tstshu tstshun dha ra'i rus pa blangs nas gang gi khyim du sbas na 'chi'o/ /tstshu tstshun dha ra'i sha dang nya'i zhag dang bcas pa lha la mchod pa byas nas dur khrod du thod pa'i steng du 'dug nas thod pa bzung la bzlas pa bya/ dur khrod kyi sol ba la lan stong du blugs cing /

sbyin sreg byes na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de tsha ba gsum dang bsres pas las su 'gyur ba ni/ gang gi khyim du bzhag na/ de la me'i tsha ba gsum dang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de ske tshe dang bsres pas kyang las de nyid du 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de dang dur khyod kyi sas gzugs brnyan byas te sgo rtsar sbas na/ phral du na tshas gsod par 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de lan tshwa dang bsres nas gang la brdeg pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phye ma de yungs kar dang bsres nas rgyal po'i sgo la gtor na/ rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ tstshu tstshun dha ra'i rtog pa zhib mo rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī pam̐ ka ra dang / bod kyi lo tstsha ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mā ri kṛṣṇa karm+ma sarb+ba tsa kra siddha ka ra nā ma tant+ra ra dza/ bod skad du/ gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gi thos pa du gcig na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsum mo'i bha ga la gti mug rdo rje dang / ser sna rdo rje dang / 'dod chags rdo rje dang / zhe sdang rdo rje dang / phrag dog rdo rje dang / sa rdo rje dang / chu rdo rje/ me rdo rje dang / rlung rdo rje dang / byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po ma dang / yon tan gyi phreng ba ma dang / sems kyi rgyud tshim par byed pa ma dang / brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo ma dang / bdug spos ma dang / me tog ma dang / mar me ma dang / dri chab ma dang / de la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dang / thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas lha mo bai lī stan las langs te thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da ltar 'di na gdug pa can rnams kyis sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar bgyid pa dang /

ma 'ongs pa na yang theg pa chen po pa dang / sems can thams cad la'ang 'tshe bar bgyid pa dag 'byung na de rnams ji ltar tshar gcad par bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das bgegs thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las snying po 'di phyung ngo / /hrīḥde ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das nyid zhal drug pa phyag drug zhabs drug pa'i ngo bor gyur nas ma he rwa gnyis pa brdzis te/ ma he'i bdag po chung ma bcas par oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā zhes zhal bzhad pa dang bcas pas oṃ gsung zhing mnan par gyur to/ /lha dang lha ma yin dang bdud thams cad kyang skrag cing 'dar ba dang bcas pas 'dud par gyur to/ /tshangs pa dang / dbang pa la sogs pa thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan khro bo yi/ /rgyal po chen po rab 'jigs pa/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /de nas sgrub pa bshad bya ba/ /rtsibs brgyad dbus kyi lte ba la/ /bdag nyid phyag dang zhal rnams ni/ /drug drug ldan par gyur pa bsgom/ /zhabs kyang de dang 'dra ba ste/ /g.yas kyi dang po'i phyag na ni/ /rdo rje tho ba g.yas gnyis na/ /ral gri de bzhin g.yon gyi yang / /dang por zhags pa sdigs 'dzin ldan/ /gnyis par gtun shing legs par 'dzin/ /rdo rje dril bu tha mas bsnams/ /steng zhal nag po rab 'jigs pa/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung ste/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis zhabs bzhir gnas/ /stag lpags kyis ni rnam dkris shing / /seng ge se ral ral pa ni/ /gyen 'gred bsdus te spyi bor yang / /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par bcings/ /'di ni khro bo 'chol pa ste/ /lag cha sna tshogs dag dang ldan/ /shar rtsibs la sogs rnam bzhi la/ /gti mug sogs te bzhi po yang / /dkar dang ser dang dmar ba yang /

/de bzhin bzhi ba ljang gu ste/ /g.yas kyi 'khor lor rin chen 'bar/ /padma sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /g.yos gyis dril bu legs par 'dzin/ /mtshams su lam̐ sogs las skyes pa/ /lha mo bzhi po nges par bsam/ /bdag po 'dra ste sgeg nyams 'dzin/ /grwa yi lha mo mtshan la ni/ /sgeg mo khu tshur dkur ldan no/ /rin chen phreng ba phyag gnyis bsnams/ /pi wang sgrogs pa'i gsung dbyangs can/ /gar gyi rgyas par 'gro ba yi/ /don la rtag tu brtson 'grus ldan/ /bdug spos sogs dang bzhi po yang / /rang gi mtshan ma nges par 'dzin/ /phyag rgya'i sngags rnams brjod pas so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gti mug rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dzi na dzi ka /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos ser sna rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ rataṇa dh-i ka /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi bdag pos 'dod chags rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ā ro li ka de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos phrag dog rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pradzñā dhṛ ka de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sa rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ lo tsanā hūm̐/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos chu rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ mā ma kī trāṃ/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos me rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃpaṇḍa ri bā hrīḥ/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rlung rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ta rā āḥ/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos bde ba chen po skyed par byed pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/

/oṃ lā sye/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos yon tan rgyud pa ma'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ mā le/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi bdag pos dbyangs can ma'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ gī ti/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi bdag pos gar ma'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ nṛ tye/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi bdag pos mchod pa'i sngags 'di gsungs pa ni/ oṃ badzra ddhū pe/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ oṃ badzra dī pe/ oṃ badzra gandhe/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad 'gugs par byed pa'i sngags dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzhug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bcings pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su dgyes par byed pa'i sngags rnams bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gsungs pa ni/ oṃ badzra am̐ ku sha dza/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa bam̐/ /oṃ badzra ā be sha hoḥ/ blo ldan mkha' pas ci nus kyi/ /thig gi thig ni gdab pa la/ /tshad ldan 'jur mdud med pa dang / /gsher zhing sar pa mdzes pa yis/ /shar du bltas te gdab par bya/ /tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab pa yang / /lho ru bltas te gdab par bya/ /de 'og mtha' yi thig gdab pa/ /byin zar gnas te dbang ldan blta/ /rlung gnas bden bral kha bltas te/ /nub tu legs par bri bar bya/ /der gnas shar du kha bltas te/ /byang du bris te byin zar gnas/ /bden bral min pa'i mtha' ma gdab/ /blta ba bden bral phyogs su'o/ /slob dpon ldan min grogs po ni/ /ri dgas zhon pa'i phyogs 'dug ste/ /tshangs thig dang po gdab par bya/ /gnyis pa'ang bden bral phyogs 'dug ste/ /bgegs brkyang la gdab par bya/ /dbus dang mtha' mar phye ba yi/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gru bzhir bgyi zhing sgo bzhi dang /

/rta babs bzhi ni brgyan pa yi/ /dbus su rtsibs brgyad lte ba la/ /rdo rje tho ba bri bar bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus nyid du/ /gri gug kyang ni bri bar bya/ /shar rtsibs 'khor lo chen po ste/ /rin chen lho yi phyogs rtsibs la/ /padma dmar po nub tu bri/ /byang du rdo rje kun du rtse/ /shar lho phyogs su'ang de dang 'dra/ /grwa bzhir brgyad po'ang nyis brtseg tu/ /mtshan ma rnams ni legs par bri/ /sgo bzhi dag tu bri ba yang / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /gzhan yang rgyan kun legs par bri/ /mchod pa legs par dgram par bya/ /khu tshul dku gnyis bzhag pa dang / /de bzhin dpral bar nyug pa dang / /kha nas 'byin dang gar bskyod dang / /bdug spos nyug dang me tog 'thor/ /mthe bong bsgreng ste rang lus la'ang / /gzhan la nyug tshul gnas pa ni/ /brgyad po mchod pa'i lha mo dag /bskyed dang legs gnas phyag rgya yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams dag /rang lus bcug ste gnas pa la/ /sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā badzra swa bhā ātma ko3ham̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bha ba ātma ko3ham̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3ham̐/ mig sogs byin gyi brlabs pa la/ /gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bsrung / /dbang sgrub stong pa nyid byas te/ /snying po'am ming gi yi ge yi/ /rigs kyi phyag mtshan bsnams pa yi/ /sku rnams nges par bskyed pas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag pos bdud rtsi myang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dag cing 'bar bar rnam brtags te/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i bdag po ste/ /zla ba'i dbus su gti mug bsam/ /rin chen dbus su bsam pa yang / /ser sna nyid du bsam par bya/

/padma'i dbus su 'dod chags bsam/ /sna tshogs dbus su phrag dog bsam/ /bsam bya ljags la sa bon te/ /'phros pas bkug ste tshim par bya/ /shar ni dkar po chen po ste/ /lho ni ser po nyid du'o/ /nub tu dmar por nges par shes/ /byang ni ljang gu yang dag ldan/ /de las de bzhin re khā'i rim/ /dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe na yang / /byams dang snying rje dga' btang snyoms/ /tshad med pa yi rim pa yis/ /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po rnams/ /yod min med min gnyis ka min/ /gnyis ka min pa'ang ma yin te/ /spros bral ngo bo med par bsgoms/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3ham̐/ ram̐ las nyi ma rnam bsgoms te/ /de dbus las kyi rdo rje ni/ /kun tu rtse lnga'i rang bzhin te/ /de dbus hūm̐ las rdo rje ni/ /kun tu phra mos bgegs bcom ste/ /ra ba gur dang sa gzhi yang / /de yi 'og tu nges par bsgom/ /gru gsum gyen bsgreng dkar po ni/ /shin tu gsal bar bdag gis dmigs/ /zhe sdang las ni sngar ma byung / /byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems la gzhol ba dang / /gtong zhing thos pa'i khengs pa med/ /le lo bcom zhing khro ba med/ /ser sna med de g.yo yang med/ /sgyu spangs shes rab gsal ba dang / /gcig tu theg pa che la gzhol/ /des ni dka' ba med pa yang / /gzhan gyi don du 'di brtsams na/ /grangs ni bye ba tshang ba yi/ /bcu bzhir tshang ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /las rnams kun grub the tshom med/ /yang lha mos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de yi 'khrul 'khor ji lta bu/ /yi ge rnams ni ji ltar bri/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ /bdun tshan bdun dang ldan pa yi/ /re'u mig legs par bri bar bya/ /las kun byed pa'i 'khor lo la/ /mchod pa yis kyang legs mchod la/ /de 'og las rnams brtsams par bya/ /bzlas pa'i mtshan ma rmi lam mam/

/mngon sum byung bar gyur nas kyang / /'khrul 'khor rnams ni bri bya ba'i/ /rmi lam mtshan ma 'di yin te/ /tshal chen zug pa'i gling dag dang / /lha khang mchod rten gzhal yas su/ /dam pa rnams dang nges phrad de/ /dbang bskur ri la 'dzeg pa dang / /rgya mtshor bcas pa'i chu brgal lam/ /kla klo bran du 'khol rmi na/ /nges pa 'grub ste 'khor lo bri/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa gsungs te/ /yam̐ las byung ba'i rlung dkyil 'khor/ /sngon po gzhu yi dbyibs can la/ /ba dan ldan par nges par bsam/ /ram̐ las byung ba'i me dkyil 'khor/ /grub gsum dmar po bsam par bya/ /bam̐ las byung ba chu yin te/ /dkar po zlum po bsam par bya/ /lam̐ byung sa yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ljang ser gru bzhi bsam byas te/ /sngon du bsam bya lta rim bzhin/ /twa ra phyi nas nges par bsam/ /bhrum̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /drug gnyis ldan pa'i lte ba la/ /bhrum̐ las gzhal yas khang pa ste/ /gdan dang ldan par sgrub pos bsam/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyi bde bar gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa bsdu bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ lag ngar gnyis ni nges bsnol la/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul byas te/ /se gol brdab cing bsdu bar bya/ /lcags kyu la sogs rnam pa bzhis/ /nges par dgug pa la sogs bya/ /de nas yang bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos mchod pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ pra bar satkā ra pratī tstsha swā hā/ nag por ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan par/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin par ras bzangs dag gis dkri/ /'dam mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang / /dri dang ldan pa'i kha brgyan te/ /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang /

/ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor la yang mchod/ /'dzam bu'i gling ngam gling gzhan dag /nor bu rin chen bkang ba yang / /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ /zhum pa med par byas te dbul/ /blo ldan sgrub pos sems can la/ /phan pa'i sems kyis srog mi gcod/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa mi spyad brdzun mi smra/ /gnod pa'i rgyu phyir chang mi btung / /gdug pa rnams las bzlog ste bya/ /dngos su'am yang na sngags dang gzhan/ /'khrul 'khor dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sman gyis kyang ni bya ba ste/ /de ltar mi byed de yi ni/ /nges par dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /gdon dang log 'dren dag gis kyang / /nges par 'chi ste dmyal bar ni/ /yun ring sdug bsngal gyis sdug ste/ /de bas nan tan ldan pa ru/ /bzod pa mi bskyed snying rje yis/ /sngags kyi nges par gsad par bya/ /mi ldog pa yi sems su gnas/ /byang chub chu yi ra ro zhing / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /phyag rgya che la de gzhol te/ /ngo bo dang bral dngos po 'jig /ma byin byang chub blang ba la/ /brtson pas le lo dor bar bya/ /brdzun du shes bya dngos po rnams/ /de nas de bzhin gzhan la brjod/ /rgyas btab pa yi dngos po la/ /rgya bshig shes rab ral gri yis/ /bcad cing rnam pa med pa la/ /bsad pa yang ni nga yis bsgrags/ /u med pa yi yi ge rnams/ /steng gi g.yas phyogs nyid nas bri/ /'og gi yi ge bri ba ni/ /de nyid g.yon gyi phyogs nas bri/ /ā li kā li ngas bris te/ /kṣaḥm gtogs par dbus stong ste/ /de la bgegs kyi mtshan ma'am/ /ming sogs nges par bri ba yang / /lto ba'i nang du chud par bri/ /'khor lo nyid kyang de 'dra ba/ /grwa bzhi dag tu bri ba ni/ /ma ning 'dod pa'i kā li dang / /ā li min te lhag ma yin/ /gdug pa'i yi ge bcu bzhi po/ /ming dang bcas pa phyogs bzhir bri/ /dbyings kyi yi ge bzhi pa yis/

/bzhi pa gcig gi mgo stengs su/ /sum skor nyid ni shes pa yin/ /las kun byed pa'i 'khor lo de/ /'dri bar byed pa'i spyi dus dang / /khyad par dus tshes lha yi ni/ /rnal 'byor med pas bya ba ni/ /phyogs su blta ba'i bye brag gis/ /las yi sgrub pos shes par bya/ /las kun byed pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /bde gshegs kun gyi snying po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'ang yin/ /'khor lo 'dir ni bcug pa gang / /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig /dam chos smod pa'ang de bzhin zhi/ /'khor los sgyur ba'ang dbang du 'du/ /lha min pra ti'ang zhi bar byed/ /dgra bcom gsod pa'ang de zhi ba la/ /brgya byin nyid kyi dbang du nges/ /de lta bu yi 'khor lo de/ /thog mar bris te de 'og tu/ /byin rlabs ma nor de nyid la/ /mchod pa gus par bdag gis bya/ /mchod min las rnams byas pa la/ /'bras bu 'byung min 'khrul pa la'ang / /'bras med ngal ba nyid yin no/ /yang lha mo ro langs ma nyid stan las langs te mchod pa chen po byas te 'di skad ces gsol ba btab bo/ /'khor lo 'dri ba'i snag tsha gang / /bri gzhi smyu gu ji lta bu/ /gcig gam 'on te de tha dad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par nyon la yid la zung shig dang ngas bshad do/ /ji ltar las rnams bye brag yod pa ltar/ /bri ba'i gnas dang gzhug pa'i gnas/ /tha dad de bzhin 'khor lo bsgrub/ /snag tsha tha dad 'bru rnams bzhin/ /grong khyer chen po bsrung 'dod dam/ /skyes pa bsrung bar 'dod na yang / /gro ga de bzhin u bhi shun/ /gla gor zho sha'i shun pa'am/ /ras la kha ches 'khor lo ni/ /bskul ba'i tshig dang ldan par ro/ /so ma btang ba'i kham phor du/ /sbrang mar dag dbus 'khor lo gzhug /skud pa dkar pos legs par dkri/ /nang par shar du kha bltas te/ /me tog dkar po dag gis mchod/

/bdag nyid dkar po'i mdog tu bsam/ /mdun du skyes pa zla ba la/ /mtha' dag gnas pa 'dun du bsam/ /sangs rgyas phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yis/ /bdud rtsi lngas gang bum pa yi/ /chu rgyun dag gis dbang bskur te/ /de 'og bzlas pa brtsams par bya/ /swā hā'i sngon du bskul tshig ldan/ /bud med la ni gi wang ste/ /phyi rol mtshams bzhir phur pa yis/ /bgegs bskrad steng du bla re bre/ /phyi ma skyes pa'i ji bzhin no/ /bye brag tu yang skyes pa'am/ /bud med zhi bar 'dod na yang / /ga pur tsandan dag gis ni/ /shir sha shing gi shun pa la/ /'khor lo yi ge legs bris te/ /shar du nang par bltas te mchod/ /las kun byed pa'i thabs la yang / /sngon gsungs zhal ldan dgod par bya/ /phyi rol mtshams bzhir phur pa yis/ /bgegs bskrad steng du bla re bri/ /bum pa kha rgyan dang ldan zhing / /rin chen 'bru dang sman du ldan/ /dri zhim chu dang ldan par bya/ /gos bzang kyis ni mgrin par dkri/ /phyogs bzhi dag du gzhag par bya/ /thang ka'am dkyil 'khor la mchod de/ /dri'am chu dang me tog dang / /bsres pa'i skyor mos chu yang blugs/ /gzar bu stong gis sbyin sreg bya/ /chu des gzhan yang gtor bar bya/ /bar ma chad pa nyin bdun du/ /de ltar rgyun du gtor ma sbyin/ /phyi nas 'khor lo rin chen de/ /bum pa'i nang nas rnam phyung ste/ /rgyal mtshan rtse la btags nas su/ /gnas mthon por yang gzhag par bya/ /zhi bar byed pa the tshom med/ /sngar bshad pa yi shing shun dang / /dur khrod ras la sgrub po yis/ /yung ba'i khu bas 'khor lo bri/ /so ma btang ba'i kham phor du/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes sa dag dang / /snang mdzad chu ngogs sa dag dang / /ri dang lam sa btags nas ni/ /ldong ros dang ni yung ba yi/ /khu bas sbrus te gzugs byas la/ /'khor lo gnyis dril yung ba dang / /ldong ros kyi ni khu bas bsku/ /snying gar bcug ste gzhug par bya/

/seng ldeng phur pa sor brgyad pas/ /lus la sogs pa gdam pa bya/ /dgra rnams 'ong ba'i lam du yang / /khur bur brkos te gzhug par bya/ /lam̐ las dbang chen gyis mnan cing / /sum̐ las skyes pa de steng na/ /sna tshogs las kyis mnan pa yi/ /kham phor skud ser dkri bar bya/ /rgyal chen dag ni ser po yang / /dbang chen la gnas lhor bltas te/ /bsgrub bya ser po'i rigs mnan pa/ /bsams nas bzlas pa brtsams par bya/ /swā hā med par stam̐ bha ya/ /lam̐ gyi mtha' can lnga stong bzlas/ /gtor ma rgyud du sbyin par bya/ /rengs pa chen po'i lan 'di yis/ /dmag gi dpung yang nges par rengs/ /'ga' tsam la ni smos ci dgos/ /sran ne lan gsum bsngags pa yis/ /dur khrod ras la 'khor lo bri/ /rims dang dug gis zin pa de/ /de yi steng du gzhag par bya/ /bdag nyid dkar por rnam bsams te/ /cho gas byab cing gdon par bya/ /de ni de nas zhi bar 'gyur/ /ngag dag rengs par 'dod na yang / /smyo byed khu ba dur khrod sol/ /btsag rnams bsres te so ma btang / /kham phor gnyis la 'khor lo 'di/ /pho dang mo yi skor phyogs gnyis/ /ma nor bris te kha sbyar la/ /ro bsregs so dang thal ba g.yogs/ /steng du bzlas shing spel ba ni/ /stam̐ bha na dang ku ru lam̐/ /swā hā med pa'i sngags 'di yis/ /kha bcing ba ni nges par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gsad par byed pa la/ /snying rjer ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /gdug byed las 'di byed pa la/ /gshin dgra lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /zhag gcig gis ni 'grub par byed/ /bcu bzhi nyi ma phyed pa na/ /bya rog sgro rtsa'i smyu gu yis/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras dag la/ /dug dang tshwa dang ske tshe dang / /nim pa tsha ba gsum dag dang / /tsha ba'i mar khu dur khrod sol/ /smyo byed mdzub mo'i khrag gis bri/ /ro bsregs pa yi thal ba dang / /bsgrub bya'i rkang pa'i rjes kyi sa/ /mi yi rus phye la sogs la/

/gzugs byas de yi snying gar gzhug /dur med dag la de 'gro zhing / /khros pa'i sems kyis khro bzlas na/ /skad cig tsam gyis 'chi ba ni/ /de yi khyim mam dur du sba/ /de lta'i las kyi de 'grub ste/ /mtshan mo phyed na kha lhor blta/ /bdag nyid 'jigs pa'i gzugs can te/ /zhal sogs sngon du gsungs pa ltar/ /ma he'i steng na mche ba gtsigs/ /gsus khyim che la gyen skra 'bar/ /spu sogs gzhan yang de 'dra'o/ /ba spu dag gis bu ga nas/ /'jigs mtshon sna tshogs thogs pa yi/ /khro bo mang po 'phro ba ste/ /bdag nyid bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar/ /bsgrub bya mdun du bsam bya ba/ /mtshams med rdzogs pa'i sdig dang ldan/ /dri ma can de phyogs gos 'chang / /grong khyer skye bos 'tshe ba can/ /grang ba'i reg pas lus la rgyas/ /mtshon gyis btab pa byas pa la/ /gcan gzan sogs za mdun du bsam/ /ngag tu'ang de ltar yang yang brjod/ /lcags kyi 'khyud mos yan lag bsdams/ /tsher mas dbug pa byas pa ste/ /lus kyi pags pa med par bsam/ /ske tshe lan tshwas lus byugs te/ /a chu ba yi sgra 'byin bsam/ /de yi mgon skyabs bsal bya nas/ /gshin rje'i lto ba'i tha mar gzhag /be con thogs pas de za'o/ /'di ltar bsad pas sangs rgyas kyi/ /sras su de ni skye bar 'gyur/ /las kyi sdig las de grol lo/ /gsod pa'i sngags de spel ba ni/ /hūm̐ che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐/ /bsgrub bya nang dag dbye ba ni/ /ma he rta yi pags dag /yang na ro dang dur khrod ras/ /rta dang ma he byi la'am/ /khyi dang nim pa'i 'dab khu dang / /khyim bya'i khrag dang ske tshe bsre/ /der ni 'khor lo 'di bris te/ /rnam par 'gras ba bskul dang ldan/ /rta sbal dag gi nang bcug ste/ /ma he'i rmig pa'i nang bcug la/ /stong phrag bcu ni tshang bar bzlas/ /nim pa'i shing bsros de nang sba/ /de nang 'gras pa nyid dang ni/ /dpag tshad brgyas chod 'thab par 'gyur/

/a nu ki dang a mu ki /bi dwe ṣa ya phaṭ/ rims kyis thebs par bya ba la/ /dur khrod ko ba che ba la/ /arka shing gi lo ma dang / /tsi tra ka nang ske tshe dang / /khrag gis 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /bri ba bskos la ri mos dgang / /seng ldeng 'dab ma du med la/ /bsro zhing khros pas lnga brgyad bzla/ /khyim dang lam gyi gzhi mdo dang / /dur khrod sbas na rims kyis 'dzin/ /rgyas pa'i las kyis rgyas 'dod na/ /ging wang gis ni gro ga la/ /'khor lo gnyis ni rnam bris te/ /bskul tshig ldan par yi ge bri/ /zla drug thang ka'i mdun dag tu/ /gnod sbyin dang ni gnod sbyin mos/ /rin chen char ni 'bebs pa dang / /gshin dgra ser po zla ser la/ /gnas par bsams te khro bzlas na/ /'phags pa nor 'dzin 'dra bar 'gyur/ /oṃ che ge mo puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ /gro ga sogs kyi shog shog la/ /gi wang dang ni rang byung gi /me tog dag gis bri ba ste/ /yang na tha ltag khrag dang ni/ /bil ba'i lo ma'i khu ba dang / /ras dmar po yi khu ba dang / /sen rtsi rnams bsres bri bar bya/ spra tshil gyis ni 'khor lo dril/ /bum pa mar sbrang ldan par gzhag /dus bzhi dag tu mchod pa ni/ /me tog dmar pos mchod pa'o/ /de tshe bzlas pa tshul dag ni/ /hoḥwā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ/ /de ma thag tu lha rnams kyang / /dbang du byed par nges 'gyur ro/ /gro ga dag la bri ba ni/ /zla ba gzas zin dus dag gam/ /rgyal gyi nyin par bri bya ste/ /skud pa dmar pos 'khor lo dkri/ /me tog dmar pos mchod par bya/ /thod pa kha sbyar nang gzhag ste/ /bzlas pa khris ni brgya byin gyi/ /bu mo'ang rnyed par nges 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras dag la/ /gur gum sogs kyis 'khor lo bri/ /yi ge thig les rnam bskos te/ /a mu ki dang mā ma kī/ /mo ha na dang rnam spel la/ /bsgrub bya'i gos kyi mtha' ma la/ /legs btags chos kyi dbyings nyid du/

/bsgoms nas zlos shing 'gro na yang / /lha dang lha min gyis mi mthong / /bdag nyid gshin dgra nyid bsgoms nas/ /chu yi steng nas 'gro 'dod na/ /rdul phran lha yi rnam par te/ /o ḍyan du ni bdag rang nyid/ /nges par steng 'gro gzhan dag kyang / /bu mos nags kyi ras bal ba/ /skud pa bka' ba gzhon nu mas/ /sum sgrol du yang de yis bya/ /gdug sngags stong du tshang bar te/ /bzlas tshul sngon du gsungs pa bzhin/ /skar ma rgyal gyi dus la bzla/ /bri ba'i nyi mo'ang de la'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lhar brtag pa/ /g.yon gyis mdud byas gzhan la gdags/ /ma lus mtshon ngag rengs byed de/ /gcer bu ba lang rengs par byed/ /me tog las ni gzhan du min/ /sha lnga sogs kyi ril bu ni/ /legs par grib ma dag la bskam/ /lcags gsum dag gis dkri bar bya/ /bzlas shing mchod pa byed pa'i tshe/ /dngul dag gi ni rang bzhin bya/ /'bar bar gyur pa nyid na yang / /mchod pa legs par rnam byas te/ /skor ba brgya phrag du ma bya/ /de nas blo ldan sgrub pa pos/ /khar bcug tsam gyis 'dod pa bsgrub/ /phyung na sngon ltar rnal ma nyid/ /gso ba 'dra bar 'o mas kyang / /nges par 'khrul 'khor bkru bar bya/ /rig sngags 'khrul 'khor las grol te/ /rnal ma nyid gnas pa yin/ /snum ster dag gis sa bon la/ /nya lcibs dang ni byi tang ka /khu bas yang de byugs pa la/ /thod pas sa ni rnam bkang bar/ /sbas te bzlas pa grangs med bya/ /de tshe mchod dang gtor ma dag /yongs rgyas 'bras bu rnam blangs te/ /khar bcug mkha' 'gro'i byar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ /zhus dang 'das dus byung gdug pa/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par spros pa dang / /thing gis gzhal yas mtshon pa dang / /rdul tshon phyogs las rnam par brtags/ /yang dag byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang bar bya ba dang / /tshangs ba'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa dang /

/sngags kyi dngos med de bzhin mtshams/ /chos 'byung dang ni sgrub po dang / /bzlas dang de yi grangs tshad dang / /'khor lo dang ni yi ge gnyis/ /nges par zhus dang mchod pa dang / /'khor lo 'dri ba'i mtshan ma dang / /'byung ba bzhi dang bsdu sogs dang / /sdom pa 'khor lo'i yi ge bri/ /gzhi dang de bzhin snag tsha dang / /so so las kyi bye brag ste/ /bsdus te nga yis bstan pa yi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'byung po rnams la gtor mas tshim par bya ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las sngags 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ hrīḥṣḍira'aḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ /'byung po rnams dang rnam spel te/ /tha mar sbyar ba byas pa ni/ /hi hi hi hūm̐ phe ྃphe ྃphe ྃswā hā/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam bzhugs pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin gshed rdo rje ni/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu las/ /snying rje'i thabs kyis sku sprul pa/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa'i/ /dud pa mun chen sku la 'dud/ /gar dgu nyams dang ldan pa yi/ /gti mug rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed/ /skye med don dam ngang nyid las/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed drag po'i cha lugs can/ /zla ba nya 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /ser sna gshin rje'i rdo rje ni/ /'dzin pa po las grol ba yis/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor sprul/ /gter 'chang ser sna grol mdzad pa/ /btso ma gser 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /chags pas ma lus dbang mdzad pa'i/ /'dod chags gshin rje'i rdo rje ni/ /skye med rnam dang chos dbyings las/ /khams gsum pa dag khro bar sprul/ /ma chags spyan ldan thugs rje can/ /ban bu lta bu'i sku la 'dud/ /shes rab pha thams ldan he ru ka /phrag dog gshin rje gshed rje'i rdo rje ni/ /rnam rtog dpe dang bral ba las/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i khro bo ni/

/'gro don brtson pa'i ral gri can/ /sna tshogs mdog can khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad bskyed pa'i lha mo che/ /dbang po lta bur sgyur mdzad pa/ /khams gsum gzugs pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /rnam snang can gyis bdud bzhi 'jigs/ /bde ba chen pos rtag tu dgyes/ /ye shes spyan can khyod la 'dud/ /kun sdud lha mo rin po che/ /rnam rtog skyon las rnam grol yang / /dus gsum bde gshegs bdag gir byed/ /rin chen tog can mdzes pa'i sku/ /don dam thugs chud 'khor ba sel/ /ma lus kun gyi bdag la 'dud/ /'dus byas ma lus sreg byed pa/ /rnam rtog zhi ba'i rang bzhin las/ /khams gsum ma lus sgrol bar byed/ /'od dpag med kyi rab mdzes pa/ /ma chags phyag na bsnams pa yi/ /phrin las dag byed can la 'dud/ /thugs rjes g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can/ /'jig rten gsum dag sgrol bar byed/ /gnyis med bde chen ngang nyid las/ /phrin las grub pa'i rang bzhin can/ /btang snyoms bzhugs pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /kun tu las kyi rgyal la 'dud/ /ces gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa la so sor yongs su bstod do/ /de nas yang thams cad kyi bdag pos legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ /lha mo rnams kyi sku la btud de/ /gdug pa 'jigs pa'i yi ge ni/ /bcu bzhi pa la dmigs pa yang / /'khor bar dmigs par bya ba'am/ /nyi ma'i steng na skyes pa ltar/ /dmigs te ma yengs brjed pa med/ /bzlas pa nyid ni de ltar bya/ /bye ba tshang bar bzlas pa yis/ /rab 'byam las la mi 'grub pa/ /med de de yi thams cad 'grub/ /'bum dang sa ya bzlas pas kyang / /phra mo'i las rnams 'grub par byed/ /gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni/ /de lta'i tshul du bzlas pa bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /mi 'phro sems kyis 'di zlos shing / /lam du zhugs pa'i skyes bu la/ /stag sogs chu yis mi 'jigs so/

/de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dbang gi blo sbyangs rab ldan pas/ /'bras thob de med mi 'grub ste/ /de bas de ni bshad par bya/ /bum pa'i dbang gis thog mar sbyang / /gsang ba'i dbang gis gnyis pa ste/ /gsum par bya ba de nyid ni/ /shes rab ye shes de yin te/ /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yin/ /brtan g.yo dngos po ma lus pa/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid la/ /blos ni yongs su mi bsgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid ma shes na/ /bsgom pa kho na de min te/ /thams cad dngos nyid yongs shes na/ /de ni bsgom par yongs su bsgrags/ /de nyid bla ma'i kha yis te/ /'bad pas mnyes bya de mi smad/ /de la thams cad 'byung ba ste/ /bla ma la smod g.yo sgyu can/ /nges par de ni dug dang yang / /gdon chen dag ni ma lus pas/ /'chi zhing brlags par de gyur nas/ /dmyal ba dag tu yun ring ltung / /bskal pa du mar sdug bsngal te/ /rtag tu cho nges 'debs par byed/ /de bas blo gros chen po la/ /nam du'ang mi smad gzhan du na/ /bkur sti phu dud 'gro ba la/ /phan pa'i sems kyi de ltar bya/ /gzhan yang bsgom par bya ba nyid/ /gang dag dbang po'i lam 'gro ba/ /de de'i go bor bdag gis bya/ /bsam gtan mi byed de blo yi/ /kun tu blo yis bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan bdag po chen po yis/ /gsang dbang lag na rdo rje la/ /bos nas gsang ba'i dbyangs 'di gsungs/ /gzugs sgra la sogs drug po rnams/ /dngos med mkha' dang 'dra ba las/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ bsnams par mdzod/ /mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /gar gyis dgyes pa'i rol pa mdzod/ /rig bya dgag pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol par mdzod/ /ho chags pa med pas chags par mdzod/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /sngags dang phyag rgya dbang bskur ba'i/

/de yi mtshan nyid bshad pa'i phyir/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /lce la sgom pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje gnod mdzes nag po ste/ /kha ni kun du gyes pa yi/ /lag gnyis thal mo nges sbyar te/ /gung mo'i rtsa ba'i tshigs nyid la/ /mthe bong nges par sbyar bar bya/ /mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab rtsir sbyar/ /'di ni dam tshig phyag rgya ste/ /snying ga dpral pa lkog ma dang / /spyi bor byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ a dhi tiṣṭha swa māṃ/ /gzhan yang rdo rje sems ma sogs/ /phyag rgyas dbang bskur dbu rgyan brtag /gti mug rdo rje sogs pa/ /so so'i bdag pos dbu brgyan cing / /dbang bskur tshe na bum pa che/ /phyag gis bsnams te dbang bskur ro/ /'khor lo las kun byed pa la/ /gsang dbang lag na rdo rje yis/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis bstod/ /gug pa skrag byed 'khor lo me ltar 'bar/ /dus gsum khro rgyal he ru ka yi thugs/ /las rnams dag byed phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /ma lus tshems gcod gsol bas sku yi ngang / /hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi gdug rtsub sbyor bas gsung / /kun gyi rang bzhin khyod kyis gshin rje yi/ /ltor 'dzud bka' las ngas kyang mi 'da' zhing / /phyogs bcu'i sprul pas gnas nas 'gugs mdzad pa/ /ma lus kun byed 'khor lo che mchog la/ /gzhan gyi don rdzogs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dpa' bo thub chen kun gyi bdud/ /nga yis lam bstan bdud rnams mi phyed kyang / /dam las 'da' zhing log pa kun bskyed la/ /khyod kyang bka' las ma 'da' las rnams sgrubs/ /tshe dang srog bsdus yan lag rnam par bcings/ /bdud rtsi chu rgyun rnal 'byor nga la 'dod sgrub na/ /ngas ni sbyin bya khyod ni dam las ma 'da' zhig /ces dpal gshin rje'i dgra nag po'i 'khor lo gzhan gyi lto ba la gnas 'cha' bar 'dod pa'i gtan 'pho ba ma yin pa'i tshe bya'o/

/'khor lo snying gar lta ba'i tshe/ /sa bon tshul te lte ba la/ /yi ge ma lu 'dod pa yang / /mtshan nyid ngan pa'i rtog pa las/ /grol te mtha' gsum ngo bo las/ /kṣaḥni zad pa'i bdag nyid la/ /u ni hūm̐ gi bdag nyid de/ /de ni sems kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /dga' las 'das pa'i ye shes te/ /thabs ni shes rab ldan pa las/ /dus thabs bstan pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /'thob ste gzhan du de mi 'thob/ /chu 'gram chen po bas mtha' dang / /dur khrod shing drung dgon pa ste/ /dben pa'i yul dang ma mo'i khyim/ /der ni mgon po 'di la 'bad/ /gzhan du bsgrubs kyang de mi 'grub/ /skad cig de la rang bzhin kun/ /nges par mi snang rig pa yi/ /lam du gyur pa med par shes/ /'bras bu de ni rgya chen te/ /mtha' yi 'thob pa de yin no/ /de nas yang thams cad kyi bdag po bde bar gshegs pas rdo rje sa'i cho ga gsungs pa na skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /bsrung ba'i dkyil 'khor rab gnas pas/ /sdang ba'i log 'dren skye bo dang / /bgegs rnams bsal ba 'di skad gsungs/ /dpal ldan bdag ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /bdag gis ye shes rdo rje yis/ /lus ngag yid du bcas pa dag /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid ni/ /khro bo gshin rje nag po'i bdag /slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni drung nyid du/ /dar gyis gdong ni bkab pa la/ /sgo drung gnas pa khyod gang yin/ /slob dpon gyis ni rab brjod de/ /des bdag skal ba ldan par brjod/ /ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis/ /mgon la dbang ni bskur ba bzhin/ /bla med byang chub gnas bya'i phyir/ /bdag la'ang mgon pos dbang bskul gsol/ /me tog sogs te mchod pa'i mchog

/rab 'byam rgya mtsho ma lus pas/ /slob dpon dpa' bo de nyid la/ /yang yang mchod cing bstod pa'i tshogs/ /rgyas par mnyes bya de 'og tu/ /dpa' bos de la dbang rnams sbyin/ /de nas rgyal po bde chen po/ /dpa' bo longs spyod kun ldan pa/ /'gro don brtson pa'i sku gsum bdag /nyid kyi 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /sbyin sreg med na 'bras mi 'byin/ /de bas bdag nyid dam pa yis/ /de yi las la 'bad par bya/ /gos nag rgyan gyis rnam brgyan la/ /gshin rje rnam bltas rnal 'byor pas/ /khro bo'i skyil krung bcas pa yis/ /sra ba'i stan la bdag 'dug nas/ /las rnams bsgrub par bya ba ni/ /mtshan mo'am nyi ma phyed nyid na/ /ram̐ byung me yi dkyil 'khor du/ /hūm̐ phaṭ mtha' na yod pa yi/ /sngags kyi thog ma bar tha mar/ /sbyin sreg bya ste de me ni/ /dur khrod me'am rus pa'am/ /rdo nyid las ni byung ba'am/ /tsanḍa lī yi khyim nyid nas/ /thab khung grub gsum can der ni/ /tsher ma can gyi bud shing brdzang / /rlung g.yab sbar te hūm̐ dzwa la ram̐/ /dzwa la hūm̐ brjod me sbar brjod/ /lag g.yas ku sha bcas pa yis/ mthe bong srin lag rtsa ru gzugs/ /oṃ e hye hi ma hā bhū te de ba ṛ ṣi dwi dza satta ma gṛ hī twā ā hā ti ā hā ram̐ a smin sam̐ ni hi to bha ba zhes brjod la spyan drang ngo / /'bar ba me yi dbus nyid du/ /ming de zad byed ces bya ba/ /khro bo me ltar phun sum tshogs/ /ba spu kham pa de bzhin du/ /du mdog zur mig steng du gzigs/ /sgra che mche bzhi ldan stobs che/ /yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /bzhugs nas drag po'i yi ge brjod/ /spyan gsum pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /rig pa'i gnas la legs par bzhugs/ /zhal bdun rnam gtsugs ma he la/ /chibs pa du ba'i phreng rnams 'khrigs/ /phyag gnyis mdung dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnyis kyis ral gri gri gug 'dzin/ /de yi g.yas kyi phyogs nyid du/

/de bzhin mdun gyi phyogs nyid dam/ /spyan drangs byin brlabs ldan pa la/ /arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa bya/ /oṃ arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ /lag g.yas mdzub mo mthe bong dag /skam pa lta bur rnam byas pas/ /chu blangs bskyod pas dbul bar bya/ /oṃ pā tyaṃ mthar ni sngon gyi brjod/ /zhabs bkru ba la shis pa yis/ /dgang gzar yu ba sor bcu drug /de min sor bzhi zabs sor gnyis/ /zur gsum dbus su sor gnyis tshad/ /rtse gsum phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /de yi dbus su'ang mtshan ma ste/ /stag sbrul gang 'dod pas mtshan bya/ /khu bcug 'dzag pa sor gcig go /khro bo rdo rje mchu yi dbyibs/ /byin brlabs sor gcig tshad can no/ /blugs gzar yu ba sor bcu bzhi/ /zabs su sor gcig gru gsum dang / /yu ba'i mthar ni rtse gsum pa/ /gdengs pa byin brlabs mngon spyod kyi/ /gzar bu yin par nga yis bstan/ /gnam lcags tsher ma can sogs shing / /de la de byas sangs rgyas 'jigs/ /bsreg rdzas gzugs brnyan la sogs bsreg /stong du tshang pas 'bras bu ni/ /nges par 'byin par byed ma yin/ /g.yon gyi rtsa der dgang gza' la/ /g.yas pa blugs pa'i gzar bu yin/ /kha ni padma'i 'dab ma yin/ /sor mo gnyis par de rgyas so/ /rdo rje bar gyi thod pa dag /bsreg rdzas kyi ni snod yin la/ /rdzas rnams rdo rje ring chen dpal/ /hūm̐ phaṭ kyi ni mtha' can gyis/ /bsreg bya sa chu me dang rlung / /nam mkha' lta bu'i dbus su gnas/ /kha bye gnas pa rtag tu'o/ /kun tu'ang kha phye bskor bar bya/ /bzhi gnyid 'dab ma'i steng du ste/ /lte ba dang ni yang dag ldan/ /lhan cig rnam par shes pa'i lha/ /nam mkha'i nyid du nges par 'bar/ /de yi mtshan mar shes bya ba/ /rdul gyi rnam par de nyid do/ /thig le yi ge med pa ste/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'od kyis gnas/ /brgyar gshags skra yi tshad kyis so/ /arghas rab tu sbar bar bya/

/sngar gsungs 'byung ba rnam bzhi dang / /nam mkha' yang dag ldan pa yi/ /sor mo lnga dang nges ldan pas/ /gang gi sbyin sreg des bya'o/ /gzhan dag sor mo gsum gyis bsreg /dmigs pa thams cad 'gag par 'gyur/ /rten med stong pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /phyag rgya chen po dbang du 'gyur/ /bde gshegs kun dang mnyam 'gyur ba/ /shes rab dang ni snying rje ches/ /'gag pa med pa'i chos 'gyur ro/ /bde chen nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dmigs pa yin/ /mdog nag 'dab brgyad lta bu la/ /rgya dang zabs su sor mo ni/ /nyi shu de bzhin bcu pa'i thab/ /byang du rtse mo bstan pa la/ /rdo rje tho ba'i mtshan ma de/ /sor ni bzhi par bri bar bya/ /de steng sor mo gsum bor bar/ /kha khyed kyang ni de yi tshad/ /sa nag bong bu rnga mo'i spangs/ /mi rus 'bras kyi phub ma dang / /sol ba'i phye mas rnam byugs la/ /mi zhib dri dang bdug pas mchod/ /dur khrod shing ngam bong bu dang / /rnga mo'i spangs skam bud shing ngo / /sor gcig gis ni dma' ba yin/ /nim pa de bzhin seng ldeng dang / /se ba de bzhin bse shing dang / /dur khrod shing bu sor bcu pa/ /tsa ba'i cha las rnam byung ba/ /dur khrod mar khu rnams bsnyugs la/ /de yis yam shing bya ba yin/ /bya rog 'ug pa'i gshog pa dang / /nim pa'i 'dab ma thal ba dang / /rkang rjes sa dang bong bu dang / /rnga mo sogs kyi sbangs dang ni/ /skra dang zhag dang bshang ba dang / /gci ba mi rus yungs kar dang / /yungs mar khrag dang lan tshwa dang / /de la sogs pa re re zhing / /ji ltar rnyed pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /dug dang khrag dang smyo byed kyi/ /'dab khu thal ba sol ba dag /'bras kyi phub ma la sogs la/ /dgra bo dag gi gzugs byas la/ /mgo nas brtsams te ral gri yis/ /dum bur gtub cing lcags phor du/ /khrag dang chu dang mi rnams dang / /bong bu'i gcin la phaṭ ldan pa'i/

/gdug pa'i yi ge rnams bzlas pa'i/ /rdzas la bsang gtor byas nas kyang / /slob dpon la sdang rmongs pa 'di/ /brjod cing sbyin sreg dbul bar bya/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ /'byung po tshim bya gtor ma dang / /bstod bzlas mnyes par bya ba dang / /dbang gi dbye ba bstan pa dang / /dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya ba dang / /de yi sa la mchod pa sogs/ /cod pan du ni bde gshegs gzhag /mngon spyod hom gyi cho ga dang / /bsdus nas bar du rnam pa brgyad/ /padma dkar 'dra mgrin pa ring / /gzugs mdzes ha cang ring ba min/ /lus la rdul byung yid 'phrog ma/ /dri ni shin tu'ang zhim pa yin/ /lta stangs mig sogs ri dgas 'dra/ /mgrin dang ltar ba'ang ri dgas kyi/ /skal bzang rked pa'ang ri dgas kyi/ /glang chen dri ldan bzhin 'phel che/ /myos shing du ma rab tu rgyas/ /gzhan yang kun rdzob bden pa ni/ /bong thung de yi skra yang thung / /rkang lag ring zhing bzhin ring ma/ /nya yi dri bro bong ring ma/ /zla 'dra skye gnas rab tu ring / /skyes gnas chung zhing yan lag rtsub/ /bong ring de bzhin nu ma mkhrang / /skra srab dal smra yan lag chung / /sngo bsangs ri mo mnyam pa de/ /gsang ba shes rab rnam gnyis la/ /rig mar nga yis bsgrags pa yin/ /ngang pa'i 'gros can skra 'khyil ma/ /bzhin zlum nu rgyas lus kyang rgyas/ /shin tu ring min dal bar smra/ /dbus nas rna 'phyang gnyer gsum can/ /mtshan nyid ngan zhing le lo che/ /yan lag nag cing skra 'khyil ma/ /khang par gnas shing lus rtsub ma/ /sa li'i dri 'byung sa li bro/ /nu yangs de ni skyes bu bzhin/ /chang gis myos pa'i dpa' mo ste/ /chang la shin tu chags pa yin/ /de gnyis de la shis pa yin/ /tha ma tha mar nges par yin/ /'chi ba'i bsam gtan de nyid ni/ /bde ba dam pa kho bos 'dod/ /'di la'ang bde ba de nyid yin/ /ka sogs spangs pa'i ā li ni/ /bcu drug yin te phrag gnyis po/

/'khor lo sogs pa'i sa bon yin/ /zla ba de dag sum cu gnyis/ /ā sogs spangs pa'i kā li ste/ /bcu bdun gnyis pa de steng du/ /ya sogs spangs pa min pa nyid/ /gsum pa'i gsum dang bzhi pa'i gnyis/ /bcu phrag bzhi ste de phrag gnyis/ /sen mo zangs songs sa bon te/ /nyi mar rnam bsgrags de dbus gnas/ /hūm̐ dang a yi rang bzhin las/ /rdo rje tho sogs so sor rtog /thim pas nan tan ye shes te/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid dag pa ste/ /gshin dgrar bdag nyid 'dod pa yin/ /rgyan gyi bye brag lus la gnas/ /de ni 'di skad bya ba ste/ /rig pa shes rab bstan pa dang / /bskyed pa'i rgyu yi bye brag ni/ /tha mar bstan te sdom gsum mo/ /mtshon par byed pa'i bdag nyid de/ /mtshon bya sngon bstan nyid yin no/ /gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i las thams cad grub par byed pa'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs s+ho// //panḍi ta bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas/ /rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī rakta ya mā ri tant+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rje btsun gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ e ma'o byang chub sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po phyag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i snying po gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rang bzhin nyon cig phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ 'dir gsungs pa'i gshin rje 'joms par byed pa ji tsam zhig mchis/

gti mug rdo rje'i gshin rje'i gshed dang / phra ma rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed dang / 'dod chags rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed dang / phrag dog rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed ces bya'o/ rdo rje tsa rtsa kā dang / rdo rje phag mo dang / rdo rje dbyangs can ma dang / rdo rje gau rī ma rnams kyang ngo / /mtshams rnams la bum pa rnams so/ /de lta bu la sogs pa'i gshin rje 'joms pa'i tshogs rnams kyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po bdud thams cad 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nyid kyi sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje rnams las phyung bar mdzad pa ni/ /sngags kyis 'gugs dang dbang byed che/ /de bzhin mthu yi cho ga mang / /ral gri bsgrub dang rgyal po dang / /pha rol dmag tshogs rnam 'joms dang / /mi snang mig sman bcud len dang / /de bzhin grib gnon rig pa dang / /ro langs gnod sbyin sgrub pa dang / /sbrul gdug la sogs bsrung pa dang / /sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor las rnams dang / /byang chum sems kyi rnam dpyod dang / /thabs rnams kun gyi spyod pa dang / /pha rol grong du 'jug rnams la/ /'od zer rnam lnga 'khrigs pa yi/ /rdo rje bsrung ba'i don du bsgom/ /rdo rje sa gzhi'i cha rnams la/ /ra ba gur rnams de bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bskyed par mdzad pa/ bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa thams cad kyi sa bon 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams las nges par phyung ngo / /ya ni dbus su ste/ kṣe ma me da ya tstsha ni rā dza sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra/ /dang por ya las gshin rje'i gshed/ /kṣe yig las ni rmongs par brjod/ /ma yig las ni phra mar bshad/ /me yig las ni 'dod chags nyid/ /da yig las ni phrag dog ste/

/gshin rje'i gshed rnams lnga ru grags/ /dza yig tsa rtsi kār bshad do/ /sa yig las ni phag mo'o/ /do yig dbyangs can mar bshad do/ /ru yig gau rī mar 'dod do/ /ṇa yo ni ra mtshams bzhi la/ /mi yi thod pa rnam pa bzhi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms pa zhugs nas zhe sdang chen po'i rigs bsgom pa'i rnam 'byor gsungs pa/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod par ldan/ /ro gcig mkhas pas sems can don/ /byams sogs yon tan kun tu rdzogs/ /thos pa'i rgyun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dang por kha sogs yongs su gsang / /snga bar snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /rab tu brtson pa dben pa'i phyogs/ /dur khrod sogs su bde ba'i gdan/ /dben zhugs nyin kyi thugs kar ni/ /pad nyid blta zhing 'od rab 'bar/ /de yi 'od kyis bkug byas nas/ /sems can don rnams phun sum tshogs/ /bsgom bya bla ma sangs rgyas rnams/ /ji snyed ma lus dam mkha'i mthil/ /dmigs te phyag 'tshal de rnams kyi/ /sku yi bkod pa rnam par bsgrub/ /tsa rtsi kā sogs rnams kyis mchod/ /de las sdig pa rab tu bshags/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis/ /yang dag sdig gyur byas de bzhin/ /bdag gis de bshags gang zhig yang / /dus gsum mgon mdzod rjes yi rang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshungs rnams kyis/ /bsod nams tshogs la rjes yi rang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos dang / /tshogs mchog rnams la bdag skyabs mchi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gis lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /gnas dang chos kun ston pa dang / /shin tu mthar yang mdzes pa dang / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /de nyid sbyin sogs gzugs can gyi/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /bsten cing 'di la rab tu dad/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed phyir/ /byang chub sems dag bdag gis bskyed/

/gang zhig bsod nams nyer bsags rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag gis bsngo/ /'gro 'di kun la phan mdzad phyir/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed gyur/ /lhag par smos lam 'di byas pas/ /de rnams la ni gshegs su gsol/ /brtse bas byang chub bzhin du blta/ /khams gsum rnams ni stong par bsam/ /rang bzhin gyis ni sbyor bral bas/ /rgyu dang de bzhin mtshan nyid la/ /rnam par rtog pa bral ba dang / /lha dang smos lam rnams par spangs/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3ham̐/ yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ bzhi la dkyil 'khor bsdus nas bhrum̐ yig las skyes pa'i gzhal yas khang bsgom par bya'o/ /zur bzhi pa dang sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa la/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis spras pa/ /lha dang lha mos shin tu mdzes/ /ba dan dril bu bcas pa rnams/ /sna tshogs rtse mo rlung gis bskyod/ /bam̐ yig las ni de dbus gnas/ /sna tshogs padma rnam par bsam/ /de yi ze 'bru'i dbus gnas la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dbyug par bcas/ /yongs su gyur las mtha' dag rtags/ /zhe sdang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rim mtshungs padma nyi ma la/ /ma he dmar po'i steng du ni/ /sprul pas bdud rnams ma lus pa/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan par bya/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od 'bar lha/ /ro langs ma yis mgu nas 'khyud/ /dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /klu brgyad kyi ni rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum dmar zhing 'jigs su rung / /mgo bo dmar po brgya yi phreng / /g.yas na rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang / /g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /khro bo'i mtshungs par ldan pa dang / /ljags ni bskyod cing mche ba gtsigs/ /khro gnyer sku mkhregs rked pa la/ /stag gi pags pas rnam par brgyan/ /thung zhing lto 'phyang rngam zhing 'bar/ /shin tu rnam dag dri ma bral/ /ro langs ma yi g.yas gri gug /g.yon na mi yi thod pa'o/ /spyan gsum skra ni grol ba dang /

/phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba mtshangs par ldan/ /ro bcud 'dzin pa gtso bo yi/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ rdo rje tsa rtsi kā dang snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /lho'i 'dab ma la phra ma gshin rje'i gshed kha dog ser po/ rdo rje phag mo dang snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /nub kyi 'dab ma la 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kha dog dmar po/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma dang snyoms pa zhugs pa'o/ /byang gi 'dab ma la phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kha dog ljang gu rdo rje gau rī dang snyoms pa zhugs pa'o/ /tsa rtsi kā nag mo'o/ /phag mo ser mo'o/ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo'o/ /gau rī sngon mo'o/ /g.yon pa na thod pa dang g.yas pa na gri gug go /phyag dang zhal dang sku mdog yang dag par gnas pa ni dpa' bo ji lta ba bzhin no/ /me'i mtshams na mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba'o/ /bden bral du gser gyi bum pa gla ba yis gang ba'o/ /rlung du byi ru'i bum pa sihlas gang ba'o/ /dbang ldan du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba'o/ /thod pa yis kha g.yogs pa rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po la sogs pa dpa' bo gtso bo'i sngags gsungs pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ snying po sngags so/ /oṃ hauṃ kṣauṃ kṣa yam̐ kā rā ya gṛhnagṛhna phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā yakṣe senā dhi pa ta ye ma hā du ra dā na ta da ma kā ya nā sha ya/ bi drā pa ya bi drā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ phreng sngags so/ /oṃ dwe ṣa ra ti nu da nu da tru ṭa tru ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ rje btsum ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ mo hā na ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phṭa/ oṃ bi shu nā na ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā gā na ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ī ra ṣyān ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dpa' bo bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ mo hā ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ/

oṃ mo hā ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ/ oṃ pi shu na ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ/ oṃ rā ga ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ/ oṃ ī raṣyā ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ/ dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ma bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ mar me mar mā bi ghā te oṃ badzra tsa rtsi ke ha ra ha ra bukka ma rā ya che ge mo la dzaḥ/ oṃ gho ṇe su gho ṇe badzra mā ma kī/ bha ra bha ra/ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ dzaḥ/ oṃ mar me mar mā kṣo bhaṇī badzra sa ra swa ti da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra/ pha ra pha ra/ kam̐ pa kam̐ pa/ dhu na dhu na hūm̐/ /che ge mo la dzaḥ/ oṃ gambhī re badzra kā ra ti ke gha gha/ rakta sho ṇa ti pri ye gau rī che ge mo la dzaḥ/ gdengs ka'i dbang po dga' bo ni/ /sngon pos skra bcings 'jigs par byed/ /klu 'jog dmar pos rna ba la/ /brgyan cing rtse mo 'khyil ba ste/ /rig ldan khra bos dpung pa brgyan/ /lag gdub gdengs ka dung skyong ser/ /shin tu dkar ba pad do shal/ /mtha' yas sngon po mchod phyir thogs/ /shin tu mdzes par byas pa'o/ /bdud rtsi'i kha dog gdengs ka ni/ /nor rgyas kyis ni cod pan byas/ /padma'i sdong bu'i kha dog dkar/ /rkang gdung padma chen po yis/ /thams cad phu tā'i yi ge sgrogs phyag gnyis pa dang mche ba gtsigs/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gshin rje 'jigs pa zhes bya la/ /rnam rtog thams cad 'joms pa yi/ /sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya/ /mkha' khyab rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi/ /lcags kyus kun bkug khar zhugs nas/ /bde ba snying khar zhugs shing zhu/ /de las spros byas sa bon rnams/ /de zhu rdo rje'i lam nas ni/ /rang 'od padma'i na mthar gnas/ /de bltas sa bon rang gzugs la/ /de yi sa bon las skyes pa'i/ /'khor lo sa bon kun byin brlab/ /me stag 'phro ba'i tshogs gsal ba/ /cho ga bzhin du mkhas pas bsgom/ /blta zhing snying gar bzhu byas la/ /rdo rje'i lam nas dbyung bar bya/ /rang rig padma'i ze 'bru la/

/lha yi tshogs rnams blta byas la/ /sna tshogs me tog la sogs dbul/ /lag na lo ma 'dzin rnams kyis/ /legs par mchod par bya ba ste/ /mchod pa'i glu ni yid 'ong dang / /sna tshogs gar gyi rang bzhin dang / /de bzhin bde ba chen pos mchod/ /e ma gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ /bla ma sron po'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag ni khyed mthong 'jigs pas na/ /bla ma srin po'i rang bzhin spangs/ /mtho ris sa stengs sa 'og rnams/ /khyod kyi gar gyis g.yo bar byed/ /khrag gi mig sman khro bo'i sems/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs gzugs/ /dmar zhing thung ba'i tshad ldan pa/ /rnam pa mang po'i sprul gzugs byed/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis zhus/ /khyod kyi gar mdzad bde ba che/ /khyod kyi hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥ'i sngags kyi gar/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel/ /brtse bas khro ba'i rje btsun khyon/ /'gro la lta zhing gar mdzad do/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ātma ko3ham̐/ sgra yi tshogs pa thams cad la/ /sgra snyan dang ni mtshungs par blta/ /'khor lo yi ni 'dren pa la/ /de yi de la de bzhin bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /rdo rje'i thugs dang rab mtshungs pa'i/ /rin chen rdo rje'i phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /gsung mchog kun gyi rab mchog ste/ /gsung gi rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po las kun pa/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab mchog gtso/
