/rnga bran rnams kyang zur la dgod/ /ba lang sna dang glang chen sna/ /de bzhin bzhin bzang bzhin ngan ma/ /gtun shing dang ni sta re dang / lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa 'o/ /gar la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgo bzhi la ni rtag tu bsgom/ /nas ljang snye ma dang bcas bsam/ /rang gi rtags rnams de bzhin g.yas/ /ji ltar rta mchog gi ni sngags/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi yang ngo / /rta mchog bsgom pa'i sbyor ba las/ /khams gsum mkha' la rgyu bar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las dngos grub nges pa'i rim po phye ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //de la 'dir thig gdab pa'i dam tshig mchog ni/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā ṇā mā dya nu tpa nna twā ta/ dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed gzugs/ /slob ma rnam par snang mdzad bya/ /ye shes thig mchog rtse dag gzung / /mnyam gzhag nas ni legs par gdab/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por rab tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig go /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur ring ba la/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha yis sbom/ /ba yi rnam lngas legs par byug /skud pa gnyis su med par brtag /de la 'di ni rdo rje chen por rab tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig ste/ /kye ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /kye ma chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la byin/ /de la 'di ni sa chen po yongs su gzungs ba'i dam tshig go /rdo rje sa yi lha mo spyan drangs la/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /sgo ni dkyil 'khor brgyan cha ru/ /bdag nyid chen pos shes bya ste/ /khams chen po ni ma gtogs pa'i/ /tshad ldan shin tu mdzes pa 'o/ /sgo dang sgo khyud des shes bya/ /de yi phyed kyis snam bu ste/ /glu ma rnga ma gar ma sogs/

/rdo rje'i lha mo yang dag ldan/ /de yi phyed kyis rdul tshon sa/ /sgo yi phyed kyis 'gram dang logs/ /'dir yang dra ba dra phyed dang / /nyi ma zla ba me tog phreng / /lha yi snam bu dang po'i tshad/ /de bzhin phyi yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la snying po chen po 'di/ /bdag gis 'khor lo nam mkhar dgod/ /rang gi phyag rgya'ang de ru brten/ /dam tshig ye shes gzhug byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgrub par bya / /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lho ru ser po dang ldan pa/ /dmar po nub kyi cha la ste/ /byang du ma ra ka ta ldan/ /ind+ra nī la'i 'od mtshungs pa/ /dbus kyi sa gzhir yang dag bri/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /de yi phyag rgya dgod par bya/ dbus su rdo rje yang dag bri/ /shar la 'khor lo legs par bri/ /de lta bu la sogs par blta/ /phyag rgya rtag tu nam mkha' mtshungs/ /de la blugs gzar dgang gzar tshad/ /'di yi tshad kyis yu ba bya/ /khru gang tshad dang ldan pa la/ /de yi rtse mor dkyil 'khor bya/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad ldan la/ /gting du sor gnyis za pa la/ /de la sor phyed bcud khung du/ /blugs gzar padma'i rnam pa bzhin/ /mthe bo'i lto gang tshad la ni/ /gting du sor mo'i tshad ldan no/ /rgyud 'di la ni rab tu bsngags/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs shing / /mtshams med lnga ni byas pa dang / /gang gis srog chags gsod pa dang / /nya dang sha sogs za ba dang / /chang dang 'dod ma la chags dang / /chad lta'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dang / /mngon par dbang ni ma bskur dang / /bya ba ma yin byed spro dang / /grong khyer dbyen byed bas kyang ni/ /dmar po'i gsung ni ji lta bar/ /gshin rje gshed rgyud mchog la gzhol/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi rdo rje'i chen po'i sngon med pa'i gsung thos pas cang mi smra bar gyur to/

/de la 'di ni rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig ste/ /de yang 'byung ba'i sa bon che/ /'khor lo bzhi po rab bsgrub bya/ /gnas bzhi rab tu sbyong ba yis/ /nam mkha' yang ni g.yo bar byed/ /rkang pa dag gi 'og tu yam̐/ /lte bar ram̐ ste snying go lam̐/ /mgo bo la ni bam̐ yig go /gzhu yi rnam pa nag po che/ /gtum po'i rlung ni 'jigs byed pa/ /sreg byed zur gsum me bzhin 'bar/ /nyi ma dmar po'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /ser po chen po gru bzhi pa/ /ri rab ri yis mnan pa yi/ /nor 'dzin de ni bsgom par bya/ /dkar po zlum po bum pa bzhin/ /sprin bzhin du ni char pa ni/ /stong gis rab tu gang ba yis/ /gangs kyi ri bo lta bur bsil/ /gnas bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /slob ma rdo rje can la bsgom/ /rdo rje snang ba mtha' yis sbyor/ /myur ba nyid du 'bebs par byed/ /de la 'di ni dri ba'i dam tshig go /rdo rje chos ni mgon chen po/ /snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che/ /gsungs shig 'dod chags chos chen po/ /dge dang mi dge legs par 'dri/ /khru gang nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid khru ni stong gi bar/ /slob ma chen po 'phar bar 'gyur/ /'di ni dbab pa'i dam tshig go /ri mo bri ba'i mtshan nyid rnams/ /bdag gis yang dag bshad par bya/ /sa ni snum pa blangs byas la/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mnan par bya/ /sran gre de bzhin 'o ma sha/ /bu ram bse yab la sogs pa/ /til dang nim pa'i lo ma dang / /de bzhin nā ṭī'i sa bon no/ /bar po dkar po bri bar bya/ /de la kha dog gzhan gyis bri/ /thod lo kor dang btsag dag la/ /chu yis sbyar bas rgya skyegs bzhin/ /yung ba dang ni rams dag la/ /de bzhin kha dog ljang gur 'gyur/ /sngon po rtag tu rams kyis so/ /de bzhin me drag nag po ste/ /skya bo de bzhin ba bla yis/ /de bzhin dmar po mtshal gyis so/ /ka ped khu ba de la sbyin/

/chung ngus ma yin lhag de bzhin/ /lhag pas nag po dman pa yis/ /skya bo ru ni 'gro bar byed/ /khro dang zhi ba rnam gnyis kyi/ /gzugs kyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zhi ba sgeg por gsungs pa ste/ /khro bo sbom ba thung bar thos/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad kyis ni/ /dpral ba de bzhin kha la 'o/ /mgrin pa de bzhin 'gram pa dang / /gsang gnas la ni sor bzhi'i tshad/ /sor mo nye shu bzhi yis lag /sor mo nyi shu bar lhu 'o/ /lag pa rkang pa de bzhin gdong / /mig la mthe bo'i tshad yin te/ /rna ba la ni sor gnyis gsungs/ /sgo ma'i sbubs la de bzhin bzhi/ /mchu gnyis dag la sor gnyis so/ /lte ba'i zabs su sor mo ste/ /mgrin pa ma gtogs lus la ni/ /gdong gi sum 'gyur dag tu 'dod/ /ral pa rnams ni gdong gi tshad/ /rin chen dbu rgyan sor mo drug /de nas 'phags ma sor mo yi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /gang gi bsgom pa tsam gyis ni/ /chu yi steng du 'chags par byed/ /ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /phu yig sa bon las byung ba/ /phyag la sbrul dang gzugs chen mo/ /rma bya la ni zhon par dgyes/ /shar la rma bya ma dgod do/ /lho ru de bzhin khro gnyer can/ /nub tu ri khrod lo ma can/ /byang du rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /rma bya'i sgro dang spyi blugs dang / /yal ga de bzhin lcags sgrog ste/ /de rnams rnam par bsgom par bya/ /ser po dmar po ljang gu dang / /kha dog sngon po'i dbye ba nyid/ /shes rab can gyis de bzhin bsgom/ /de bzhin du ni sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ phu dzaḥr/ tho ba la sogs sgo la dgod/ /me tog la sogs mtshams su'o/ /ārya dzaṃ gu li'i sbyor ldan pas/ /chu yi steng du rtag tu 'gro/ /de nas ku ru kulle yi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bsgom pa tsam gyis ni/ /klu yi bu mo 'gugs par byed/ /kha dog dmar po zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag brgyad dang ni yang dag ldan/

/hrīḥyig sa bon las byung ba/ /klu rnams 'gugs par byed pa'o/ /mtha' yas la sogs klu rigs brgyad/ /phyag brgyad du ni dgod par bya/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis sku la brgyan/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mdzes ma bsgom/ /sngags ni ku ru kulle hrīḥphuḥswā hā/ de nas rgyal min mdor bsdus pas/ /gsang ba pa ni bshad par bya/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha yi bu mo 'gugs par byed/ /zhal gcig ma dang phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag na mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ /lus ni ser po chen po yi/ /lus med rnam par bsgom par bya/ /shar du dga' ma bsgom par bya/ /myos byed mdzes ma lho ru bsgom/ /nub tu 'dod pa'i lha mo ste/ /byang du myos par spro ma'o/ /'dod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi/ /lag na mda' dang gzhu bsgom mo/ /ser dang dmar dang de bzhin ljang / /dkar dmar nyid rnams bsgom par bya/ /mtshams su rtag tu rgod ma dang / /ma 'gags ma dang dbang byed ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan zhes pa rnams/ /sgo yi cha la rab tu bshad/ /'dod 'gying dang ni snyems can dang / /dran pa de bzhin mtshams kyi bdag /lha rnams de dag thams cad kyi/ /spyi bor gshin rje gshed po bsgom/ /bud med rnams kyis nam mkha'i gdong / /mtha' la rdo rje lus med sgom/ /shī ta yig sngags las yang dag byung / /kun du rnam par 'phro ba ste/ /bslus shing g.yeng ba bsgom par bya/ /myos pas bde ba 'dod yid kyis/ /gos ni dmar pos yongs dkris te/ /rkang pa dag gi drung du lhung / /de la sngags ni shin tu bzla/ /oṃ yig dbyangs kyi dbye ba dang / /swā hā'i yi ge mthar mar sbyin/ /shī ta yi ge'i sngags rnams brjod/ /che ge mo ni bdag dbang gis/ /dmar po'i gsung ni ji bzhin du/ /thams cad du ni bsgoms byas na/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'dod pa 'thob/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las lus med pa la sogs pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu bdun pa'o//

//de nas he ru ka chen gyi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bas bcings pa las/ /gang zhig shes pas myur grol ba/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis te/ /sku mdog sngon po gtum po che/ /phyag na rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /gzhan la thod pa dgod par bya/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du brdzes/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /kha ṭwām̐ ga ni g.yon gyi char/ /rkang gdub chen pos rnam par brgyan/ /hūm̐ yig sa bon las byung ba/ /yi dwags steng bzhugs rtag tu 'dzum/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rab sbyor bas/ /thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /mi bskyod pa yi cod pan bsam/ /he ru kar grags rnam par bsgom/ /shar du chos kyi 'khor lo bri/ /sangs rgyas byang chub lho ru 'o/ /'dod lnga'i khro shing nub tu ste/ /byang du he ru ka dang mtshungs/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sgeg pa la/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gzugs mdzes yi dwags steng du ste/ /gti mug thams cad nyer 'joms ma/ /chos kyi 'khor lo de bzhin gzhan/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing / /bum pa bzang po de bsgom bya/ /lha mo rnams ni phyag g.yas na/ /rdo rje yang ni bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /thod pa'i snod ni g.yon du 'o/ /spyan dang mā ma kī sgrol ma/ /gos dkar shin tu yid 'ong rnams/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi la/ /phyi yi 'khor lor gshin rje gshed/ /shes rab mthar byed rta mgrin dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil bcas bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo yi ni sgo srung te/ /las rnams cho ga mthong ba yis/ /rnam pa lnga ni bsgoms byas nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo bsgom bya rnal 'byor pas/ /glu bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo can ni bskul bar bya/ /tsa rtsi kā sogs snyan pa'i glu/ /drug 'gyur la sogs glu rnams kyis/ /brtse bas khro ba'i rje btsun bzhengs/

/sa gsum po yi gti mug sol/ /bsam du med pa'i rje btsun bzhengs/ /bdud bzhi rnams las rgyal bar mdzad/ /'jig rten mgon pos stod par bzhugs/ /'jig rten bsod nams rje btsun bzhengs/ /byang chub dngos la 'jig rten mgon/ /khyod ni stong nyid sems par mdzad/ /ji ltar skar ma 'phro ba ltar/ /byang chub sems ni de la zhugs/ /brtse bas chags pa'i sems zhu ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid do/ /dang por rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /rjes su rnal 'byor gnyis pa 'o/ /shin tu rnal 'byor gsum pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po bzhi pa'o/ rdo rje sems dpa' rdzogs pa la/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /lha yi sku ni rdzogs pa la/ /rjes su rnal 'byor zhes grags so/ /'khor lo thams cad rdzogs pa la/ /shin tu rnal 'byor yin par 'dod/ /lha yi mig sogs byin brlab dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams dang / /ye shes 'khor lo rab gzhug dang / /de bzhin bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /mchod dang bstod pa chen po ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po zhes 'dod do/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /bde gshegs bka' las mi 'da' ste/ /de bzhin spun la khro ba dang / /nyes pa bsgrag par mi bya'o/ /sems can kun la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang gtang bar mi bya 'o/ /byang chub sems kyang gtang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la sun mi dbyung / /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba bsgrag par mi bya'o/ /bdag gi phung po smad mi bya/ /bcom ldan chos ni sun mi dbyung / /gdug pa'i byams pa rtag tu spang / /chos la tshad gzhal mi bya 'o/ /sems can dad pa can mi bslu/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /bud med shes rab rang bzhin la/ /smod pa'i nyes pa de bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor slong mos rgyu mi bya/ /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par kun du gsang sngags bzla/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bsten/ /gal te bag med gyur pa yis/

/bla ma'i dam tshig las nyams na/ /des ni dkyil 'khor zlum po bri/ /bde gshegs rnams la nyes pa bshags/ /dad pas bla ma'i nam tshig bsrung / /snying rje can gyis mi rtog par/ /nyes pa ma lus spang sems kyis/ /bsam gtan la gzhol bzlas mchog gzhol/ /brtan zhing dul la brtse ba'i sems/ /dad dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / /mchog tu bzod pa 'dzin pa yi/ /skyes bu rtag tu bla mar bya/ /slob ma bla ma la gus dang / /gshin rje gshed la rab gus pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyis yongs smon bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung nye bar thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /'di lta bu'i ched du brjod do/ /'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug thod pa che/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /e ma zhi ba chen po'i chos/ /e ma khro bo'i 'jigs mdzad pa/ /e ma mya ngan 'das pa'i mchog /e ma 'khor ba zhi ba nyid/ /e ma 'di ni rab tu mtshar/ /nyes pa gang de yon tan 'gyur/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa'ang med/ /khams kyang med cing rnam shes med/ /nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /nam mkha' bzhin du bdag med pa/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po 'o/ /sa yang med cing chu yang med/ /me med rlung med nam mkha' med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab sbyor bas/ /bskyed pa 'di ni rab tu gnas/ /dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad/ /des nas rang bzhin med ces bsgrags/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba dang ldan pas/ /chad pa ma yin rtag pa min/ /yan lag med cing kha dog med/ /dngos po thams cad bden par med/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' ma spangs/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas tsa rtsi kā la sogs pas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag dang ma 'brel bas/

/mchog tu dga' ba dri med rnam dag pa/ /de bzhin nyid kyi gter chen gcig pu ni/ /kun nas snying rje'i sems kyi rab tu gnas/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'di yi ngo bo ni/ /chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /gzugs med bsod nams med cing sdig pa med/ /skye dang 'gag pa dag ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las byang chub sems kyi rim par phye ba ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas gtan rgyud rab tu bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la byang chub la bar du gcad pa'i phyir shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i 'jigs pa chen po ston cing bdud kyi dpung gi tshogs chen po dpag tu med pa lhags te/ de'i dus na bdud chen po las mchog tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das nyis kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams pa las gshin rje gshed khro bo nges par phyung ste/ nges par phyung nas kyang phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i bka' bzhin byed pa la/ phyag na rdo rje khyod 'di lta ba'i gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i gzugs su bsgyur te/ bdud dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / lha dang / srin po rnams skrag cing 'jigs pa dang sod cig ces gsungs so/ /de'i dus na ji ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa thos te/ skad cig la bzung zhing don bzung ste/ bsdus nas shin tu dga' bas legs par sems bskyed do/ /gsang ba'i bdag po chen po la/ /'di skad ces ni bka' stsal to/ /pha rol grong du rab 'jug pa'i/ /thabs rnams rab tu gsal bya ste/ /'gro dang 'ong bar 'dod par yis/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gsang sngags bzla/ /bye ba bzlas pas 'grub gyur te/ /bye ba lnga yis smos ci dgos/

dang po de nas brtsams par bya/ /bdag nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /dang por goms par bya ba'i dus/ sems la sems nyid gzhug par bya dper na sems 'di rmi lam na/ /'gro dang slar yang bzlog par bya/ /skad cig la ni de bzhin gnas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sbyor goms pas/ /dper na mtshon na gnas byas nas/ /gzhu yis mda' ni 'phen pa ste/ /de bzhin 'dir yang yid kyi gzhus/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro bar byed/ /zla ba nyi ma sbyor ba yis/ /rlung gis sems ni gzhug par bya/ /lus ni rnam par spangs nas ni/ /de la yid ni 'gro dang 'jug /cung zad drod ni snyed pa yis/ /thob pa'i phyogs su sgom pa po/ /lus kyi nang du 'jug pa ni/ /dper na grong gzhan las 'gro zhing / /zla ba nyi ma'i 'gros 'joms shing / /sgra gcan 'jug pa sbyor ba yis/ /bgrod pa'i gnas ni thob pa na/ /rlung gi bzhon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'chi ltas mtshan nyid shes byas la/ /cho ga mtshan nyid ldan pas bgrod/ /ji ltar 'dod pa g.yo mi g.yo/ /rang 'dod kun tu skye bar 'gyur/ /thur sel 'og lam gsang ba'i mtha'/ /gtong zhing lte bar rtsom par byed/ /snying ga mgrin par song nas ni/ /srog ni sna bug dag nas 'gro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las pha rol gyi grong du 'jug pa ste/ rim par phye ba bcu dgu pa'o// //dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs s+ho// //bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gi 'od zer dang / bho ṭa paṇḍi ta'i gsung dang / mi'i dbang po kun dga' bzang po'i gsung dang / dpon kun gzhon gyis gser gnang ba la brten nas/ /shākya'i dge slong tsand+ra shrī'i zhal snga nas zhus shing / paṇḍi ta ches po tsand+ra kīrti dang / yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du bsgyur ro// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
